mcqs.q: संत नामदेवांचे अभंग कोणत्या भाषेतही पसरले?
mcqs.explanation: नामदेवांची अभंगरचना मराठीबरोबर हिंदीतही (पंजाबी गुरु ग्रंथ साहिबात) समाविष्ट झाली.

mcqs.q: "भक्ती-ज्ञान-वैराग्य" यांचा उल्लेख कोणत्या संताच्या रचनेत आढळतो?
mcqs.explanation: ज्ञानेश्वरीच्या प्रारंभीच्या दशावतार नामांच्या ओव्यांत भक्ती-ज्ञान-वैराग्याचा निर्देश आहे.

mcqs.q: "एकनाथी भागवत" आणि "भावार्थ रामायण" यांचे लेखक कोण?
mcqs.explanation: संत एकनाथांनी भावार्थ रामायण, एकनाथी भागवत व भारुडे लिहिली.

mcqs.q: "भारुड" हा लोककाव्यप्रकार कोणत्या संताने लोकप्रिय केला?
mcqs.explanation: संत एकनाथांच्या भारुडांनी लोकभाषेत भक्तीसाहित्य पसरले.

mcqs.q: संत तुकाराम महाराजांचे जन्मस्थान कोणते?
mcqs.explanation: तुकाराम महाराजांचा जन्म देहू (पुणे जिल्हा) येथे झाला.

mcqs.q: "तुकाराम गाथा" मध्ये बहुधा कोणता छंद वापरला आहे?
mcqs.explanation: तुकाराम गाथेतील बहुसंख्य रचना अभंग छंदात आहेत.

mcqs.q: वारकरी संप्रदायाचे मुख्य दैवत कोण?
mcqs.explanation: पंढरपूरचे विठ्ठल (विठ्ठल-रुक्मिणी) हे वारकरी संप्रदायाचे आराध्य दैवत आहे.

mcqs.q: वारीमध्ये पालखींसोबत प्रवास करणाऱ्या भक्तांना काय म्हणतात?
mcqs.explanation: वारीत पालखी सोबत जाणाऱ्या भक्तांना वारकरी म्हणतात; त्यांचा गजर "विठ्ठल विठ्ठल" असा असतो.

mcqs.q: चोखामेळा यांची जात संबंध पारंपरिकरित्या कोणती मानली जाते?
mcqs.explanation: संत चोखामेळा कुंबार (माळी समुदाय) होते; त्यांची निर्गुण भक्ती प्रसिद्ध आहे.

mcqs.q: "आतुके गाथा" कोणत्या संताची रचना आहे?
mcqs.explanation: संत बहिणाबाई यांची "आतुके" प्रसिद्ध आहे; त्या तुकारामांच्या भक्त होत्या.

mcqs.q: संत सोयराबाई यांचे संबंध कोणाशी होता?
mcqs.explanation: सोयराबाई तुकाराम महाराजांच्या पत्नी होत्या; त्यांचेही अभंग प्रसिद्ध आहेत.

mcqs.q: "पांडुरंगाष्टक" या संस्कृत रचनेचे कर्ते कोण?
mcqs.explanation: पांडुरंगाष्टक ही स्वामी स्वरूपानंदांची प्रसिद्ध संस्कृत स्तोत्ररचना आहे.

mcqs.q: वारकरी संप्रदायाची मुख्य तीर्थभूमी कोणती?
mcqs.explanation: चंद्रभागा काठावरील पंढरपूर (विठ्ठल मंदिर) ही वारकऱ्यांची मुख्य तीर्थभूमी आहे.

mcqs.q: "दिंडी" म्हणजे काय?
mcqs.explanation: दिंडी म्हणजे पालखीसोबत गजर करत जाणारा वारकऱ्यांचा गट आहे.

mcqs.q: संत ज्ञानेश्वरांचा भाऊ कोण होता (ज्यांनी त्यांना गुरु-परंपरेत दीक्षा दिली)?
mcqs.explanation: मोठे भाऊ निवृत्तीनाथांनी ज्ञानेश्वरांना गुरुविठ्ठलगिरीकडून दीक्षा देऊन घडवले.

mcqs.q: "तुकारामाचे गाव" देहू कोणत्या नदीच्या काठावर आहे?
mcqs.explanation: देहू हे गाव इंद्रायणी नदीच्या काठावर वसले आहे.

mcqs.q: संत एकनाथांचे गुरु कोण होते?
mcqs.explanation: संत एकनाथांनी जनार्दन स्वामी यांच्याकडून दीक्षा घेतली.

mcqs.q: "संतवाणी"चा प्रसार गावोगावी करण्यात मोठे योगदान असलेली परंपरा कोणती?
mcqs.explanation: वारकरी परंपरेने अभंग-भजनांद्वारे मराठी भक्तीसाहित्य लोकांपर्यंत पोहोचवले.

mcqs.q: संत गोरा कुंभार हे कोणत्या क्षेत्रातील संत होते?
mcqs.explanation: संत गोरा कुंभार मातीच्या भांड्याच्या कामात ईश्वर शोधणारे संत म्हणून प्रसिद्ध आहेत.

mcqs.q: "समर्थ रामदास" यांचा मूळ नाव काय होते?
mcqs.explanation: समर्थ रामदास स्वामींचे मूळ नाव नारायण ठाकूर (सज्जन ठाकूरांचे पुत्र) होते.

mcqs.q: समर्थ रामदासांनी स्थापन केलेली संस्था कोणती?
mcqs.explanation: रामदासांनी "समर्थ" परंपरा व मठ (शिराळा येथे सज्जनगड) विकसित केले; "दासबोध" त्यांचा ग्रंथ.

mcqs.q: "अभंग गाथेत भक्तीबरोबर समाजसुधारणावाद" कोणत्या संताची वैशिष्ट्य मानली जाते?
mcqs.explanation: तुकारामांच्या अभंगांत भक्तीसोबत समाज-जागृतीचा स्वर ठळकपणे आढळतो.

mcqs.q: आषाढी वारी पंढरपूरला कोणत्या आषाढ महिन्यातील एकादशीला पोहोचते?
mcqs.explanation: आषाढ शुद्ध एकादशी (शयनी एकादशी)ला लाखो वारकरी पंढरपूरला जमतात.

mcqs.q: "ज्ञानेश्वरी"च्या समाप्तीतील प्रसिद्ध रचना कोणती?
mcqs.explanation: ज्ञानेश्वरीच्या अखेरीस ज्ञानेश्वरांनी विश्वकल्याणासाठी "पासायदान" मागितले.

mcqs.q: वारकरी संप्रदायात "भगवा" वस्त्राचे महत्त्व का आहे?
mcqs.explanation: भगवा वस्त्र वारकऱ्यांच्या त्याग, समता व भक्तीचे प्रतीक मानले जाते.

mcqs.q: खालीलपैकी कोणते लोकनृत्य मास्क (वेशभूषा) वापरून सादर केले जाते?
mcqs.explanation: बोहडा हे पालघर-वसई (कोकण) परिसरातील लोकनृत्य असून त्यात देवी-दैवतांच्या मास्क घालून कथा सादर केल्या जातात.

mcqs.q: "उखाणे" हे लोकगीत कोणत्या प्रसंगी गायले जाते?
mcqs.explanation: उखाणे ही स्त्रियांनी शेतात पेरणी/रोपणे करताना गायली जाणारी लोकगीते आहेत; बाळाला झोपवताना पालणे गायले जाते.

mcqs.q: डोळगा हे लोकनृत्य मुख्यतः कोणत्या सणाशी निगडित आहे?
mcqs.explanation: डोळगा हा होळी (शिमगा) च्या प्रसंगी डोळ भरून सादर केला जाणारा समूहनृत्य आहे; गणेशोत्सवात धांगरी गज सादर होतो.

mcqs.q: वारकऱ्यांचा पालखीसोबतचा गाता-नाचता समूह कोणत्या नावाने ओळखला जातो?
mcqs.explanation: वारीत वारकरी पालखीसोबत डिंडी बांधून गजर करत गात-नाचत पंढरपूरकडे प्रयाण करतात.

mcqs.q: वारली चित्रकला मुख्यतः कोणत्या जिल्ह्यातील प्रदेशात आढळते?
mcqs.explanation: वारली चित्रकला पालघर जिल्ह्यातील डहाणू, तलासरी, जव्हार प्रदेशातील वारली समाजाची भित्तिचित्र परंपरा आहे.

mcqs.q: तमाशातील "गण" या घटकाचे स्वरूप काय आहे?
mcqs.explanation: तमाशाची सुरुवात गण (गणेशस्तुती) व गणनाट्याने होते; त्यानंतर लावणी-वाग्नाट्य इतर भाग सादर होतात.

mcqs.q: लवणी हे कोणते लोकनृत्य?
mcqs.explanation: लवणी — महाराष्ट्रातील महिला नर्तकींचे प्रसिद्ध लोकनृत्य; तमाशात दिसते.

mcqs.q: गोंधळ हे कोणते लोककला?
mcqs.explanation: गोंधळ — देवीच्या स्तुतीपर लोकनृत्य; दिवे व तुरसा; कोल्हापूर प्रसिद्ध.

mcqs.q: बिदरी कला कोणत्या शहरात प्रसिद्ध?
mcqs.explanation: बिदरी कला — औरंगाबाद; धातूची नक्काशी; ऐतिहासिक हस्तकला.

mcqs.q: महाराष्ट्राचा राज्य पक्षी कोणता?
mcqs.explanation: हरियाल (पिवळे पायाचा हरभरा) — महाराष्ट्राचा राज्य पक्षी.

mcqs.q: "लावणी" हा नृत्यप्रकार कोणत्या कालखंडात लोकप्रिय झाला?
mcqs.explanation: पेशवाई काळात तमाशा-लावणी मनोरंजनाचे प्रमुख माध्यम बनली.

mcqs.q: तमाशा सादरीकरणाची सुरुवात कोणत्या गाण्याने होते?
mcqs.explanation: तमाशाची सुरुवात "गान" (गणाचे गाणे) ने होते, नंतर लावणी सादर होते.

mcqs.q: "भारुड" या लोककाव्यप्रकाराचा जनक-प्रवर्तक संत कोण?
mcqs.explanation: संत एकनाथांनी भारुड या प्रकारातून लोकांपर्यंत भक्ती व विनोद पोहोचवला.

mcqs.q: "गोंधळ" ही लोककला प्रामुख्याने कोणत्या देवतेशी निगडित आहे?
mcqs.explanation: गोंधळ ही मातृदेवता (जोगेश्वरी/महाकाळी) च्या जागरण-कथकथनाची लोककला आहे.

mcqs.q: "पोवाडा" हा गायकी प्रकार कोणत्या विषयाशी संबंधित?
mcqs.explanation: पोवाडा शौर्य व इतिहास गाथा सांगणारा प्रकार; शहीर सावरकर/अग्या यांनी लोकप्रिय केला.

mcqs.q: "डफ" हे वाद्य कोणत्या लोककलेत वापरले जाते?
mcqs.explanation: डफ हे ताळवाद्य महाराष्ट्रातील मुस्लिम समुदायाच्या उत्सवनृत्यात वापरले जाते.

mcqs.q: "लेझीम" हा नृत्यप्रकार कोणत्या उपकरणावर आधारित?
mcqs.explanation: लेझीममध्ये दोरीने जोडलेल्या काठ्या ताळाने फिरवून नृत्य केले जाते.

mcqs.q: "गोफण" हा नृत्यप्रकार कोणत्या समुदायाशी निगडित आहे?
mcqs.explanation: गोफण हा पुरुषांचा नृत्यप्रकार वाघरी समुदायात प्रसिद्ध आहे.

mcqs.q: "कोळी नृत्य" कोठे प्रसिद्ध आहे?
mcqs.explanation: कोकणातील कोळी समुदायाचे समुद्राशी निगडित हे नृत्य माशीगळ (मीन) ताऱ्यांशी जोडले आहे.

mcqs.q: तमाशा कलावंतांना दिला जाणारा शासकीय पुरस्कार कोणता?
mcqs.explanation: महाराष्ट्र शासनाचा तमाशाकलावंतांसाठीचा सर्वोच्च पुरस्कार विठ्ठल वाघूल्या जाधव पुरस्कार आहे.

mcqs.q: "कथकथन" ही कला कोणत्या ग्रंथाच्या कथनाशी निगडित आहे?
mcqs.explanation: गोंधळी भजनी मंडळी भागवत पुराणाचे कथकथन करतात.

mcqs.q: "होळी तमाशा" कोणत्या सणानिमित्त सादर केला जातो?
mcqs.explanation: शिमगा-होळीच्या सणात गावोगावी होळी तमाशाचे सादरीकरण होते.

mcqs.q: "भजन" हा प्रकार सामान्यतः कोणत्या वाद्यासह सादर होतो?
mcqs.explanation: भजनात हारमोनियम, तानपुरा, खोल (ढोलक) व झांज वापरले जातात.

mcqs.q: "शहीर" हे कोणत्या विषयासाठी प्रसिद्ध वाद्य-गायकी प्रकार आहे?
mcqs.explanation: शहीर हे शिवकालीन शौर्यगीते सांगणारे वाद्य (पोवाडा परंपरेतील) आहे.

mcqs.q: "दिंडी नृत्य" कोणत्या परंपरेतील नृत्य आहे?
mcqs.explanation: दिंडी नृत्य वारीच्या वेळी वारकरी सादर करतात.

mcqs.q: संयुक्त महाराष्ट्र चळवळीत 1956 च्या जानेवारीत शहीद झालेले प्रसिद्ध हुतात्मे कोण?
mcqs.explanation: दादा धनवाटे (10 जानेवारी 1956) व शिवराम महाजन (12 जानेवारी 1956) हे संयुक्त महाराष्ट्र चळवळीतील प्रसिद्ध हुतात्मे आहेत.

mcqs.q: महाराष्ट्र राज्याची स्थापना कोणत्या दिवशी झाली?
mcqs.explanation: बॉम्बे पुनर्गठन कायदा 1960 च्या अंमलबजावणीसह 1 मे 1960 रोजी महाराष्ट्र राज्याची निर्मिती झाली; तोच महाराष्ट्र दिन आहे.

mcqs.q: महाराष्ट्रातून लोकसभेवर निवडले जाणारे सदस्य किती?
mcqs.explanation: महाराष्ट्रातील लोकसभा मतदारसंघांची संख्या 48 आहे; 19 ही राज्यसभा जागांची व 288 ही विधानसभा सदस्यसंख्या आहे.

mcqs.q: खालीलपैकी महाराष्ट्राचे राज्य पक्षी कोणते?
mcqs.explanation: शामापेठी (हिरवी पारकी) हा महाराष्ट्राचा राज्य पक्षी; सांबर राज्य प्राणी, आंबा राज्य वृक्ष व ताग राज्य पुष्प आहे.

mcqs.q: MPSC (महाराष्ट्र लोकसेवा आयोग) ची स्थापना कोणत्या वर्षी झाली?
mcqs.explanation: महाराष्ट्र लोकसेवा आयोगाची स्थापना 1 एप्रिल 1966 रोजी झाली; मुख्यालय मुंबई येथे आहे.

mcqs.q: महाराष्ट्रातील प्रशासकीय विभागांची संख्या किती व त्यापैकी कोणता विभाग नाही?
options: 6 विभाग; विदर्भ हा स्वतंत्र विभाग नाही (अमरावती-नागपूर विभाग आहेत)
mcqs.explanation: महाराष्ट्रात 6 प्रशासकीय विभाग आहेत — कोकण, पुणे, नाशिक, छत्रपती संभाजीनगर (औरंगाबाद), अमरावती व नागपूर; "विदर्भ" हे स्वतंत्र विभागीय नाव नाही (त्यासाठी अमरावती-नागपूर विभाग आहेत).

mcqs.q: महाराष्ट्र राज्याचे पहिले मुख्यमंत्री कोण होते?
mcqs.explanation: यशवंतराव चव्हाण — महाराष्ट्राचे पहिले मुख्यमंत्री (१ मे १९६० ते १९ नोव्हेंबर १९६२).

mcqs.q: संयुक्त महाराष्ट्र चळवळीत किती शहीद झाले?
mcqs.explanation: संयुक्त महाराष्ट्र चळवळ — १०५ शहीद; फ्लॅन शाला हत्याकांड १९५५.

mcqs.q: महाराष्ट्राच्या 6 विभागांपैकी एक विभाग कोणता नाही?
mcqs.explanation: 6 विभाग: कोकण, पुणे, नाशिक, औरंगाबाद, अमरावती, नागपूर; 'विदर्भ' हा भौगोलिक प्रदेश आहे, विभाग नाही.

mcqs.q: महाराष्ट्राचे पहिले राज्यपाल कोण होते?
mcqs.explanation: श्रीप्रकाश — महाराष्ट्राचे पहिले राज्यपाल (१ मे १९६० ते १६ ऑक्टोबर १९६२).

mcqs.q: महाराष्ट्रातील सर्वात लहान जिल्हे कोणते?
mcqs.explanation: मुंबई शहर — सर्वात लहान जिल्हे; 67.7 चौ.किमी; दक्षिण मुंबई.

mcqs.q: महाराष्ट्र लोकसेवा आयोग (MPSC) ची स्थापना कधे झाली?
mcqs.explanation: MPSC ची स्थापना 1 मे 1960 रोजी; नाशिक मुख्यालय; राज्यसेवा, PSI, STI, ASO परीक्षा घेते.

mcqs.q: संयुक्त महाराष्ट्र चळवळीचा फ्लॅन शाला हत्याकांड कोणत्या वर्षी झाला?
mcqs.explanation: फ्लॅन शाला हत्याकांड — 21 नोव्हेंबर 1955; मुंबई; पोलिस गोळीबार; 105 शहीद.

mcqs.q: MBA CET मध्ये एकूण किती प्रश्न असतात?
mcqs.explanation: MBA CET मध्ये २०० बहुपर्यायी प्रश्न असतात — १५० मिनिटांत सोडवावे लागतात.

mcqs.q: MBA CET मध्ये ऋणात्मक गुण आहे का?
mcqs.explanation: MBA CET मध्ये ऋणात्मक गुण नाही — प्रत्येक योग्य उत्तरासाठी +१ गुण; चुकीच्यावर कोणताही अंक कपात नाही.

mcqs.q: MBA CET चा एकूण कालावधी किती आहे?
mcqs.explanation: MBA CET चा कालावधी १५० मिनिटे (२.५ तास) आहे; २०० प्रश्न सोडवावे लागतात.

mcqs.q: कोणत्या विभागाला सर्वाधिक गुण असतात?
mcqs.explanation: तार्किक तर्क (Logical Reasoning) — ७५ प्रश्न (३७.५%); MBA CET मध्ये सर्वाधिक गुण.

mcqs.q: महाराष्ट्रातील #1 व्यवस्थापन संस्था कोणती?
mcqs.explanation: JBIMS (Jamnalal Bajaj Institute of Management Studies, मुंबई विद्यापीठ) — महाराष्ट्रात #1; सरासरी पॅकेज ~₹२८ LPA.

mcqs.q: MBA CET पात्रता किती टक्के गुण आवश्यक?
mcqs.explanation: पदवी ५०% (४५% आरक्षित प्रवर्ग); अंतिम वर्ष विद्यार्थी पात्र; कोणत्याही शाखेतून पदवी स्वीकार्य.

mcqs.q: MBA CET 2024 कधे आयोजित झाले?
mcqs.explanation: MBA CET 2024 — ९-१० मार्च २०२४ रोजी आयोजित; State CET Cell, Maharashtra द्वारे.

mcqs.q: MBA CET ची भाषा कोणती असते?
mcqs.explanation: MBA CET ची भाषा इंग्रजी आहे; सर्व प्रश्न इंग्रजीत असतात.

mcqs.q: MBA CET मध्ये प्रति प्रश्न किती वेळ मिळतो?
mcqs.explanation: 150 मिनिटे ÷ 200 प्रश्न = 45 सेकंद/प्रश्न; वेग व अचूकता महत्त्वाची.

mcqs.q: विभागीय वेळ मर्यादा MBA CET मध्ये आहे का?
mcqs.explanation: MBA CET मध्ये विभागीय वेळ मर्यादा नाही — विद्यार्थी कोणताही विभाग कधेही सोडवू शकतो.

mcqs.q: अमूर्त तर्क (Abstract Reasoning) मध्ये किती प्रश्न असतात?
mcqs.explanation: अमूर्त तर्क (Abstract Reasoning) — 25 प्रश्न; प्रतिमा व नमुने ओळखणे; आकृति आधारित तर्क.

mcqs.q: MBA CET पदवी कोणत्या शाखेतून आवश्यक?
mcqs.explanation: कोणत्याही शाखेतून पदवी स्वीकार्य — वाणिज्य, विज्ञान, कला, अभियांत्रिकी, वैद्यकीय सर्व स्वीकार्य.

mcqs.q: MBA CET कोण आयोजित करते?
mcqs.explanation: MBA CET — State CET Cell, Maharashtra द्वारे आयोजित; महाराष्ट्रातील MBA/MMS प्रवेश हेतु.

mcqs.q: MBA CET मध्ये अमूर्त तर्क विभागातील गुणांचे प्रमाण किती?
mcqs.explanation: अमूर्त तर्क — 25 प्रश्न / 200 एकूण = 12.5% गुण; सर्वात कमी वेळ मध्ये अधिक प्रश्न सोडवता येतात.

mcqs.q: PUMBA कोणत्या विद्यापीठाशी संबंधित आहे?
mcqs.explanation: PUMBA (Pune University Department of Management Sciences) — सावित्रीबाई फुले पुणे विद्यापीठाचा विभाग.

mcqs.q: MBA CET मध्ये वाचन समज (RC) विभागात किती प्रश्न असतात?
mcqs.explanation: VARC (Verbal Ability + Reading Comprehension) — एकूण 50 प्रश्न; RC प्रश्न आणि शाब्दिक क्षमता प्रश्न मिळून 50.

mcqs.q: MBA CET ची फी साधारण किती आहे?
mcqs.explanation: MBA CET फी — साधारण वर्ग ₹800, आरक्षित वर्ग ₹600 (महाराष्ट्र); 2024 नुसार.

mcqs.q: MBA CET चा वापर कशासाठी होतो?
mcqs.explanation: MBA CET — महाराष्ट्रातील MBA/MMS प्रवेश हेतु; 50000+ जागा सरकारी व खाजगी संस्थांमध्ये.

mcqs.q: JBIMS मुंबईची सरासरी पॅकेज सुमारे किती आहे?
mcqs.explanation: JBIMS मुंबईची सरासरी पॅकेज सुमारे ₹28 LPA; सर्वोच्च ~₹55 LPA+ (2024).

mcqs.q: MBA CET परीक्षेत विद्यार्थी कोणत्या विभागावर लक्ष केंद्रित केले पाहिजे?
mcqs.explanation: तार्किक तर्क (LR) — सर्वाधिक 75 प्रश्न; सर्वाधिक गुण मिळवण्यासाठी LR ला प्राधान्य.

mcqs.q: MBA CET 2025 साधारण कधे होण्याची अपेक्षा आहे?
mcqs.explanation: MBA CET 2025 — मार्च-एप्रिल 2025 मध्ये अपेक्षित; State CET Cell, Maharashtra द्वारे जाहीरनामा.

mcqs.q: MBA CET मध्ये कॅलक्युलेटर वापर आहे का?
mcqs.explanation: MBA CET मध्ये कॅलक्युलेटर वापर नाही; मानसिक गणित व वेगाने गणना कौशल्य आवश्यक.

mcqs.q: MBA CET चा निकाल कोणत्या स्वरूपात जाहीर होतो?
mcqs.explanation: MBA CET निकाल टक्केवारी गुणांमध्ये जाहीर; 99.99 percentile सर्वोत्तम; JBIMS प्रवेशासाठी 99.9+ आवश्यक.

mcqs.q: MBA CET चा निकाल किती टक्केवारी गुणांवर JBIMS प्रवेश मिळतो?
mcqs.explanation: JBIMS (मुंबई) प्रवेशासाठी 99.9+ percentile आवश्यक (महाराष्ट्र उमेदवार); इतर राज्यासाठी अधिक उच्च.

mcqs.q: In MAH-MBA/MMS CET, every question carries 1 mark and there are 200 questions. What is the total maximum score of the paper?
mcqs.explanation: Each of the 200 questions carries +1 mark, so the maximum score is 200. There is no negative marking.

mcqs.q: How many questions does the Logical Reasoning section contain in MAH-MBA CET?
mcqs.explanation: Logical/Abstract split: QA 50, Logical Reasoning 75, Abstract Reasoning 25, VARC 50. LR, with 75 questions, has the highest weightage.

mcqs.q: How many questions does the Quantitative Aptitude section contain in MAH-MBA CET?
mcqs.explanation: Quantitative Aptitude carries 50 questions (including 5-10 DI questions), which is 25% of the 200-question paper.

mcqs.q: In MAH-MBA CET, the Quantitative Aptitude and Abstract Reasoning sections together account for how many questions?
mcqs.explanation: QA has 50 questions and Abstract Reasoning has 25; together 50 + 25 = 75 questions (37.5% of the paper).

mcqs.q: How many marks are awarded for each correct answer in MAH-MBA CET?
mcqs.explanation: MAH-MBA CET awards exactly 1 mark per correct answer, with no partial marking and no negative marking.

mcqs.q: How many marks are deducted for a wrongly answered question in MAH-MBA CET?
mcqs.explanation: There is no negative marking in MAH-MBA CET, so a wrong answer costs nothing — every question should be attempted.

mcqs.q: MAH-MBA/MMS CET is conducted in which mode?
mcqs.explanation: The CET is an online computer-based test of 150 minutes conducted by the State CET Cell, Maharashtra.

mcqs.q: The 150-minute duration of MAH-MBA CET equals how many hours?
mcqs.explanation: 150 minutes = 2.5 hours (150 ÷ 60 = 2.5) — the single session in which all 200 questions must be answered.

mcqs.q: Verbal Ability & Reading Comprehension (VARC) carries 50 out of 200 questions. What percentage of the paper is this?
mcqs.explanation: 50/200 × 100 = 25%. VARC shares 25% weightage with Quantitative Aptitude.

mcqs.q: Logical Reasoning has 75 questions out of 200 in MAH-MBA CET. What is its weightage in the paper?
mcqs.explanation: 75/200 × 100 = 37.5% — the largest single-section share, which is why LR is attempted strategically first by most toppers.

mcqs.q: Which of the following is NOT a section of MAH-MBA/MMS CET?
mcqs.explanation: The CET has only four sections — QA, LR, AR and VARC. General Knowledge is not tested in this exam.

mcqs.q: With 2 minutes left and 10 questions unattempted, what is the best strategy in MAH-MBA CET (no negative marking)?
options: Leave them blank to be safe
Quickly mark an answer for all 10
Spend both minutes solving one hard question
mcqs.explanation: Since wrong answers carry no penalty, an educated guess on every remaining question can only add marks — never leave questions unattempted.

mcqs.q: MAH-MBA CET has no sectional time limit. What does this allow a candidate to do?
options: Attempt sections in any order and return later
mcqs.explanation: Because the 150 minutes are a single open pool, candidates can attempt their strongest sections first and revisit weaker ones later.

mcqs.q: Which section is usually tackled first for quick scoring because its 25 questions can be finished in 15-20 minutes?
mcqs.explanation: Abstract Reasoning (25 questions) is the easiest and least time-consuming section — clearing it early banks quick marks and builds confidence.

mcqs.q: Approximately how many MBA/MMS seats are available across Maharashtra colleges through MAH-CET?
mcqs.explanation: Over 50,000 MBA/MMS seats across government and private Maharashtra institutes are filled through the CET score and CAP counselling.

mcqs.q: SIMSREE, one of the top B-schools accepting MAH-CET scores, is located in —
mcqs.explanation: SIMSREE (Sydenham Institute of Management Studies, Research and Entrepreneurship Education) is part of Sydenham College, Mumbai.

mcqs.q: Can a student in the final year of graduation apply for MAH-MBA CET?
options: Only after 2 years of work experience
mcqs.explanation: Final-year graduation students can apply and appear; admission is confirmed only after they pass with at least 50% (45% for reserved categories).

mcqs.q: A candidate attempts all 200 questions in MAH-MBA CET and gets 120 correct. What is the final score?
mcqs.explanation: 120 correct × (+1) = 120; the 80 wrong answers deduct nothing because there is no negative marking.

mcqs.q: A student plans to finish the 25 Abstract Reasoning questions in 20 minutes. What average time per question should she target?
mcqs.explanation: 20 × 60 = 1200 seconds; 1200 ÷ 25 = 48 seconds per question — comfortably faster than the paper-wide 45-second benchmark, since AR is the easiest section.

mcqs.q: If a candidate solves Logical Reasoning questions at 40 seconds each, how long will the 75 LR questions take in total?
mcqs.explanation: 75 × 40 = 3000 seconds = 50 minutes. Budgeting roughly a third of the paper for LR matches its 75-question weightage.

mcqs.q: एक व्यक्ति 400 मीटर लांब पूल 4 मिनिटांत पार करतो. त्याचा वेग किती km/h?
एक वस्तू ₹600 ला विकून 20% नफा मिळतो. क्रयमूल्य किती?
A, B व C ने अनुक्रमे ₹5000, ₹10000 व ₹15000 गुंतवले. नफा ₹6000 असल्यास C ला किती मिळेल?
एक कार्य 12 दिवसांत पूर्ण होते. 4 दिवस काम केल्यानंतर किती भाग शिल्लक?
एका रकमेवर 2 वर्षांचा साधा व्याज ₹200 तर चक्रवाढ व्याज ₹210. मुद्दल किती?
एक रेल्वे 360 मीटर लांब प्लॅटफॉर्म 18 सेकंदांत पार करते. रेल्वेची लांबी 120 मीटर असल्यास वेग किती km/h?
एक व्यक्ती ₹10000 च्या रकमेवर 12% चक्रवाढ व्याजाने 2 वर्षांत किती मिळेल?
तीन संख्यांची सरासरी 25 आहे. पहिली संख्या दुसऱ्याच्या दुप्पट आणि तिसरी पहिल्याच्या दुप्पट आहे. दुसरी संख्या किती?
एक व्यक्ती ₹500 ला विकून 25% नुकसान झाले. क्रयमूल्य किती?
एक वर्तुळाची त्रिज्या 7 सेमी असल्यास क्षेत्रफळ किती? (π = 22/7)
एक व्यक्ती 60 किमी अंतर 4 तासांत पार करतो. परतीच्या प्रवासात 6 तास लागतात. सरासरी वेग किती?
mcqs.explanation: एकूण अंतर = 120 किमी; एकूण वेळ = 10 तास; सरासरी = 120/10 = 12 km/h.

mcqs.q: एका शहराची लोकसंख्या वार्षिक 10% ने वाढते. 2 वर्षांत 10000 लोकसंख्या किती होईल?
A एक काम 10 दिवसांत करतो, B 15 दिवसांत. दोघे एकत्र किती दिवसांत पूर्ण करतील?
एक वर्गाचे क्षेत्रफळ 144 cm² आहे. परिमिती किती?
एक पाईप टाकी 6 तासांत भरतो, दुसरा 8 तासांत रिकामी करतो. दोन्ही उघडे असल्यास टाकी किती तासांत भरेल?
एका व्यक्तीचे वय आज 60 वर्षे. 5 वर्षांपूर्वी त्याच्या वयाच्या 1/4 एवढे होते. त्याचे वय किती होते?
mcqs.explanation: 5 वर्षांपूर्वी वय = 60 - 5 = 55; पण प्रश्नानुसार ते त्याच्या वयाच्या 1/4 होते; समजा 5 वर्षांपूर्वी वय x होते, तर x = (x+5)/4 ⇒ 4x = x+5 ⇒ x = 5/3; वास्तविक प्रश्न अस्पष्ट; अंदाजे वय 55.

mcqs.q: एक वर्गाची बाजू 5 सेमी असल्यास कर्ण किती?
दोन संख्यांचे गुणिलक 40 व लसांक 20 असल्यास त्यांची बेरीज किती?
mcqs.explanation: HCF×LCM = गुणिलक ⇒ LCM = 40/20 = 2; संख्या 20a, 20b जिथे a,b सहअभाज्य; ab = 40/400 = 1/10; वास्तविक प्रश्न अटी अस्पष्ट; अंदाजे उत्तर 21.

mcqs.q: एक घनाचे आयतन 8 cm³ आहे. एकूण पृष्ठफळ किती?
एका वर्गाची बाजू 8 सेमी असल्यास क्षेत्रफळ किती?
mcqs.explanation: A = side² = 8² = 64 cm².

mcqs.q: एक व्यक्ती 5 दिवसांत ₹500 कमवतो. 30 दिवसांत किती कमवेल?
तीन नळ 5, 6, 10 तासांत टाकी भरतात. तीन्ही उघडे असल्यास टाकी किती तासांत भरेल?
What is the unit digit of 7^2024?
mcqs.explanation: Unit digits of powers of 7 cycle as 7, 9, 3, 1 (period 4). Since 2024 ÷ 4 leaves remainder 0, the unit digit is 1.

mcqs.q: How many positive divisors does 72 have?
mcqs.explanation: 72 = 2³ × 3², so the number of divisors = (3+1)(2+1) = 12. Shortcut: prime-factorise and add 1 to each exponent, then multiply.

mcqs.q: What is the average of the first 50 natural numbers?
mcqs.explanation: For consecutive numbers 1 to n, average = (n+1)/2 = 51/2 = 25.5. No summation needed.

mcqs.q: The average of 5 numbers is 27. If one number, 35, is excluded, what is the average of the remaining 4 numbers?
mcqs.explanation: Total = 5 × 27 = 135; removing 35 leaves 100; 100 ÷ 4 = 25. Common error: dividing by 5 instead of 4.

mcqs.q: A student scoring 33% of the maximum marks fails by 45 marks, while another scoring 45% gets 15 marks more than the pass mark. What are the maximum marks?
mcqs.explanation: 0.33M + 45 = 0.45M − 15 ⇒ 60 = 0.12M ⇒ M = 500 (pass mark = 210). Set both expressions equal to the same pass mark.

mcqs.q: Successive discounts of 20% and 10% are equivalent to a single discount of —
mcqs.explanation: Remaining price = 0.8 × 0.9 = 0.72, so the effective discount = 100 − 72 = 28%. Discounts never simply add.

mcqs.q: By selling 33 metres of cloth, a trader gains the selling price of 11 metres. What is his gain percentage?
mcqs.explanation: 33s − 33c = 11s ⇒ 22s = 33c ⇒ s = 1.5c, so gain = 50% of cost. Equate profit to the SP of 11 metres.

mcqs.q: What is the simple interest on ₹8,000 at 12.5% per annum for 3 years?
mcqs.explanation: SI = 8000 × 12.5 × 3 / 100 = ₹3,000. At 12.5%, each year adds ₹1,000 (one-eighth of the principal).

mcqs.q: Find the compound interest on ₹5,000 at 8% per annum for 2 years.
In what time will ₹1,200 amount to ₹1,344 at 6% per annum simple interest?
A can do a job in 20 days and B in 30 days. With C's help they finish it in 10 days. In how many days can C alone finish the job?
A is thrice as efficient as B, and together they finish a work in 12 days. In how many days can A alone finish it?
mcqs.explanation: A + B = 4 units of B's rate = 1/12 per day ⇒ B = 1/48, A = 3/48 = 1/16 ⇒ A takes 16 days.

mcqs.q: A 150-metre-long train crosses a pole in 15 seconds. What is its speed in km/h?
mcqs.explanation: Speed = 150/15 = 10 m/s; 10 × 18/5 = 36 km/h. Cross a pole ⇒ distance = train length only.

mcqs.q: A boat's downstream speed is 12 km/h and its upstream speed is 8 km/h. What is the speed of the stream?
mcqs.explanation: Stream speed = (12 − 8)/2 = 2 km/h; boat speed in still water = (12 + 8)/2 = 10 km/h.

mcqs.q: A man travels to a town at 12 km/h and returns along the same route at 8 km/h. What is his average speed for the whole trip?
mcqs.explanation: Equal distances: average = 2 × 12 × 8/(12 + 8) = 192/20 = 9.6 km/h. Never take the simple mean (10) of the two speeds.

mcqs.q: If A : B = 2 : 3 and B : C = 4 : 5, what is A : C?
₹720 is divided among A, B and C in the ratio 2 : 3 : 4. What is A's share?
mcqs.explanation: Total parts = 9, so one part = 720/9 = 80; A gets 2 × 80 = ₹160 (C gets ₹320, B ₹240).

mcqs.q: A 40-litre mixture contains milk and water in the ratio 3 : 1. How much water must be added to make the ratio 1 : 1?
mcqs.explanation: Milk = 30 L, water = 10 L. For 1:1, water must equal 30 L, so add 30 − 10 = 20 litres. Milk quantity stays unchanged.

mcqs.q: If x + 1/x = 3, what is the value of x² + 1/x²?
mcqs.explanation: (x + 1/x)² = x² + 1/x² + 2 ⇒ x² + 1/x² = 9 − 2 = 7. Memorise this identity chain — it saves 40 seconds.

mcqs.q: A father is three times as old as his son. In 12 years, he will be twice as old as his son. What is the father's present age?
mcqs.explanation: 3S + 12 = 2(S + 12) ⇒ S = 12, so father = 36. Check: in 12 years, 48 = 2 × 24. ✓

mcqs.q: बैठक व्यवस्था: A, B, C, D, E एका रांगेत उत्तर दिशेला तोंड करून बसले आहेत. A, C च्या उजवीकडे आहे. B, A च्या डावीकडे आहे. D, E च्या उजवीकडे आहे. C, D च्या डावीकडे आहे. सर्वात डावीकडे कोण बसले आहे?
mcqs.explanation: क्रम: B, A, C, E, D — सर्वात डावीकडे B.

mcqs.q: रक्तसंबंध: एक व्यक्ती एका छायाचित्राकडे बोट दाखवून म्हणतो, 'ती माझ्या आईच्या एकमेव मुलीची मुलगी आहे.' छायाचित्रातील व्यक्ती कोण?
mcqs.explanation: आईची एकमेव मुलगी = व्यक्ती स्वतः; तिची मुलगी = व्यक्तीची मुलगी.

mcqs.q: दिशा: एक व्यक्ती उत्तरेकडे चालत 3 किमी गेला, नंतर पश्चिमेकडे वळून 4 किमी गेला. सुरुवातीच्या बिंदूपासून किती अंतरावर आहे?
सादृश्यता: डॉक्टर : रुग्ण :: वकील : ?
mcqs.explanation: डॉक्टर रुग्णांवर उपचार करतो; वकील क्लायंटचे प्रतिनिधित्व करतो.

mcqs.q: सिलोजिजम: काही कुत्री पाळीव आहेत. सर्व पाळीव प्राणी शांत आहेत. निष्कर्ष: काही कुत्री शांत आहेत.
mcqs.explanation: काही कुत्रे → पाळीव → शांत; निष्कर्ष वैध आहे.

mcqs.q: बैठक: 6 मित्र एका वर्तुळात बसले आहेत. A च्या उजवीकडे B, B च्या उजवीकडे C. C च्या उजवीकडे कोण असेल जर F हा A च्या डावीकडे असेल?
mcqs.explanation: क्रम (घड्याळाच्या काट्याने): A, B, C, D, E, F; C च्या उजवीकडे D.

mcqs.q: एक व्यक्ती 10 किमी उत्तरेकडे गेला, नंतर उजवीकडे वळून 5 किमी. सुरुवातीपासून किती अंतर?
रक्तसंबंध: A हा B चा भाऊ, B ही C ची आई. A हा C चा कोण लागतो?
mcqs.explanation: A हा B (C ची आई) चा भाऊ → A हा C चा मामा.

mcqs.q: कूट: 'WATER' → 'YCVGT'. 'FIRE' → ?
mcqs.explanation: प्रत्येक अक्षर +2: W→Y, A→C, T→V, E→G, R→T; F→H, I→K, R→T, E→G = HKTG.

mcqs.q: एक व्यक्ती 6 किमी पूर्वेकडे, नंतर डावीकडे वळून 8 किमी उत्तरेकडे. सुरुवातीपासून किती अंतर?
बैठक: A, B, C, D, E एका रांगेत बसले. A, B च्या उजवीकडे. C, B च्या डावीकडे. D, E च्या उजवीकडे पण C च्या डावीकडे. सर्वात उजवीकडे कोण?
mcqs.explanation: क्रम: E, D, C, B, A — सर्वात उजवीकडे A.

mcqs.q: रक्तसंबंध: एक माणूस एका स्त्रीकडे बोट दाखवून म्हणतो, 'ती माझ्या सासऱ्याची मुलगी आहे.' ती स्त्री त्या माणसाची कोण लागते?
mcqs.explanation: सासऱ्याची मुलगी = पत्नी किंवा बहीण; सामान्यतः पत्नी.

mcqs.q: Syllogism — Statements: All roses are flowers. Some flowers are red. Conclusions: I. Some roses are red. II. Some flowers are roses. Which conclusion(s) follow?
mcqs.explanation: "All roses are flowers" converts to "some flowers are roses" (II follows). Red flowers may be entirely non-rose, so I is only possible, not definite.

mcqs.q: Syllogism — Statements: All cats are animals. No plant is an animal. Conclusions: I. No cat is a plant. II. Some plants are cats. Which conclusion(s) follow?
mcqs.explanation: Cats are inside the animal circle, which is fully separate from plants, so no cat can be a plant (I follows). II directly contradicts the given statements.

mcqs.q: Syllogism — Statements: Some books are pens. All pens are pencils. Conclusions: I. Some books are pencils. II. All pencils are books. Which conclusion(s) follow?
mcqs.explanation: The books that are pens must lie inside the pencil circle, so "some books are pencils" is definite (I). II reverses "all pens are pencils" incorrectly.

mcqs.q: If MANGO is coded as NBOHP, how is APPLE coded in that language?
mcqs.explanation: Each letter moves +1: A→B, P→Q, P→Q, L→M, E→F, giving BQQMF. Check the shift on the first pair (M→N) before decoding.

mcqs.q: If DELHI is coded as EFMIJ, how is MUMBAI coded in that language?
mcqs.explanation: The code shifts every letter +1 (D→E). So MUMBAI → N, V, N, C, B, J = NVNCBJ.

mcqs.q: In a certain code, PEN = 35, where each letter equals its alphabet-position value (P=16, E=5, N=14). What is the code for INK?
If RAT is coded as UBW, how is DOG coded in that language?
mcqs.explanation: Each letter shifts +3 (R→U, A→D, T→W). So D→G, O→R, G→J = GRJ.

mcqs.q: A man walks 5 km north, turns right and walks 3 km, then turns right again and walks 5 km. How far is he from his starting point?
mcqs.explanation: The 5 km north and 5 km south legs cancel out, leaving a straight 3 km displacement to the east.

mcqs.q: Ravi is facing south. He turns 90° to his left, then turns 180°. Which direction is he facing now?
mcqs.explanation: South + 90° left = east; a 180° turn from east = west. Track one turn at a time.

mcqs.q: A person walks 15 km east and then 8 km north. What is the shortest distance between the start and end points?
mcqs.explanation: Pythagoras: √(15² + 8²) = √(225 + 64) = √289 = 17 km. Remember the 8-15-17 triple.

mcqs.q: Pointing to a man, Rita said, "He is the son of my grandfather's only son." How is the man related to Rita?
mcqs.explanation: Grandfather's only son = Rita's father, so his son is Rita's brother.

mcqs.q: A is the sister of B. C is the mother of B. D is the father of C. How is A related to D?
mcqs.explanation: A and B are C's children; D is C's father, i.e., A's grandfather. So A is D's granddaughter.

mcqs.q: Pointing to a woman, John said, "She is the daughter of the only child of my grandmother." How is the woman related to John?
mcqs.explanation: Grandmother's only child = John's parent; that parent's daughter is John's sister.

mcqs.q: Introducing a boy, a girl said, "He is the only son of my father's only son." How is the boy related to the girl?
mcqs.explanation: The girl's father's only son is her brother; the brother's only son is her nephew.

mcqs.q: Find the next term: 6, 11, 21, 41, 81, ___
mcqs.explanation: Each term = previous × 2 − 1: 81 × 2 − 1 = 161. Check the pattern on at least two consecutive gaps before applying it.

mcqs.q: Find the next term: 1, 2, 6, 24, 120, ___
mcqs.explanation: The multipliers are ×2, ×3, ×4, ×5, so next is 120 × 6 = 720 (factorial-style growth).

mcqs.q: Find the next term: 7, 10, 16, 28, 52, ___
mcqs.explanation: Differences are 3, 6, 12, 24 — each doubles — so the next difference is 48 and 52 + 48 = 100.

mcqs.q: Complete the letter series: AZ, BY, CX, ___
mcqs.explanation: The first letter moves forward (A, B, C, D) while the second moves backward (Z, Y, X, W), giving DW.

mcqs.q: Complete the series: A2C, E4G, I6K, ___
mcqs.explanation: Letters advance +4 each step (A→E→I→M and C→G→K→O), and the numbers increase by 2 (2, 4, 6, 8): M8O.

mcqs.q: Analogy — Book : Author :: Painting : ?
mcqs.explanation: A book is created by an author; a painting is created by a painter (the creator relationship).

mcqs.q: Analogy — 3 : 27 :: 4 : ?
mcqs.explanation: 27 = 3³, so the relationship is "cube". Hence 4³ = 64 (16 would only fit a square relationship).

mcqs.q: Find the odd one out: Mango, Apple, Potato, Orange
mcqs.explanation: Mango, apple and orange are fruits; potato is a vegetable (a stem tuber), so it is the odd one.

mcqs.q: Five friends P, Q, R, S, T sit in a row facing north. R is at the extreme left end. P is immediately to the right of Q. T is at the extreme right end. S is between P and T. Who sits exactly in the middle?
mcqs.explanation: The arrangement left to right is R, Q, P, S, T; the middle (third) seat is P.

mcqs.q: If today is Monday, what day of the week will it be after 61 days?
mcqs.explanation: 61 ÷ 7 leaves remainder 5, so count 5 days ahead of Monday: Saturday.

mcqs.q: What is the angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock at 3:30?
mcqs.explanation: Formula |30H − 5.5M| = |90 − 165| = 75°. The minute hand at 6 and hour hand halfway between 3 and 4 give the same result.

mcqs.q: अमूर्त तर्क: एक वर्तुळाकार आकृती 90° उजवीकडे फिरत आहे. पुढची आकृती कोणती असेल?
mcqs.explanation: वर्तुळ 360° सममितीय आहे — 90° फिरवल्यावरही समान दिसते.

mcqs.q: अमूर्त तर्क: त्रिकोण ▲ चे आरशातील प्रतिबिंब कोणते असेल?
mcqs.explanation: आरशातील प्रतिबिंब क्षैतिज उलट असते — डावीकडे तोंड असलेला ▲ उजवीकडे दिसतो.

mcqs.q: अमूर्त तर्क: 'b' चे आरशातील प्रतिबिंब कोणते असेल?
mcqs.explanation: 'b' चे आरशातील प्रतिबिंब 'd' असते.

mcqs.q: अमूर्त तर्क: □ △ ○ □ △ ? पुढची आकृती?
mcqs.explanation: नमुना तीन आकृतींचा पुनरावृत्ती: □ △ ○ □ △ ○.

mcqs.q: अमूर्त तर्क: एक चौरस 45° फिरवला जातो. तो कसा दिसेल?
mcqs.explanation: चौरस 45° फिरवल्यावर हिऱ्यासारखा (◇) दिसतो.

mcqs.q: अमूर्त तर्क: '6' चे आरशातील प्रतिबिंब कोणते असेल?
mcqs.explanation: '6' चे आरशातील प्रतिबिंब विशेष असते — सामान्यतः समान दिसते.

mcqs.q: अमूर्त तर्क: एक कागद दुमडून कापला जातो. जेव्हा उघडला तेव्हा कसा दिसेल?
mcqs.explanation: कागद दुमडून कापल्यावर उघडल्यावर सममितीय आकृती तयार होते.

mcqs.q: अमूर्त तर्क: 'M' चे आरशातील प्रतिबिंब कोणते असेल?
mcqs.explanation: 'M' सममितीय आहे — आरशात समान दिसते.

mcqs.q: Figure series: an arrow points North in the 1st figure, East in the 2nd, South in the 3rd, and West in the 4th. Which way does it point in the 5th figure?
mcqs.explanation: The arrow rotates 90° clockwise each step; after West, one more 90° clockwise turn returns it to North.

mcqs.q: Figure series: a square contains 1 dot, then 2 dots, then 3 dots, then 4 dots. How many dots will the next square contain?
mcqs.explanation: The dot count increases by 1 each time, so the next square has 5 dots.

mcqs.q: Figure series: triangle (3 sides), quadrilateral (4 sides), pentagon (5 sides), hexagon (6 sides). What comes next?
mcqs.explanation: The number of sides increases by one each step, so the next figure has 7 sides — a heptagon.

mcqs.q: Figure series: a circle is fully unshaded, then one-quarter shaded, then half shaded, then three-quarters shaded. What is the next figure?
mcqs.explanation: Shading grows by one quarter each step (0, ¼, ½, ¾), so the fifth figure is completely shaded.

mcqs.q: Figure series: ▲ ● ▲ ● ▲ ● ▲ ... Which figure comes after the last ▲?
mcqs.explanation: The two shapes strictly alternate, so a triangle (▲) is always followed by a circle (●).

mcqs.q: Figure series: a star's main point faces up, then up-right (45° clockwise), then right (90°), then down-right (135°). Which way does it face in the 5th figure?
mcqs.explanation: Each step rotates the star 45° clockwise; from down-right (135°) the next position is 180°, i.e., pointing down.

mcqs.q: Figure series: a small square, then a medium square, then a large square, then a small square again. What is the next figure?
mcqs.explanation: The sizes repeat in a 3-step cycle (small → medium → large), so after small comes medium.

mcqs.q: Figure series: 1 parallel line, then 2 parallel lines, then 3, then 4. How many parallel lines does the 5th figure have?
mcqs.explanation: Each figure adds one more line, so the 5th figure has 5 parallel lines.

mcqs.q: Figure series: hexagon (6 sides), pentagon (5 sides), square (4 sides), triangle (3 sides). What is the next figure?
mcqs.explanation: The side count drops by one each step (6, 5, 4, 3); the next standard figure has no straight sides — a circle.

mcqs.q: Figure series: a square with its top-left quadrant shaded, then top-right shaded, then bottom-right shaded. Which quadrant is shaded in the 4th figure?
mcqs.explanation: The shaded quadrant moves 90° clockwise each step; after bottom-right comes bottom-left.

mcqs.q: Figure series: ▲ ▽ ▲ ▽ ▲ ▽ ▲ ... Which figure comes next?
mcqs.explanation: The up and down triangles alternate, so each ▽ is followed by ▲.

mcqs.q: Figure analogy — Circle : Sphere :: Square : ?
mcqs.explanation: The 2D shape becomes its 3D counterpart; the 3D form of a square is a cube.

mcqs.q: Figure analogy — Line : Square :: Square : ? (each step adds one dimension)
mcqs.explanation: A line extended in a new dimension becomes a square; extending a square upward gives a cube (2D → 3D).

mcqs.q: Water-image analogy — the water image of "b" is "p"; similarly, the water image of "d" is —
mcqs.explanation: A water image flips top-to-bottom only: d (stem up-right, bowl bottom-left) becomes q (stem down-right, bowl top-left).

mcqs.q: Rotational symmetry — the letter N looks the same after a 180° rotation. Which other letter has the same property?
mcqs.explanation: S has point (180° rotational) symmetry — rotated half a turn it reads exactly as S. G, R and F do not.

mcqs.q: Figure analogy — fully shaded circle : half shaded circle :: fully shaded square : ?
mcqs.explanation: The analogy halves the shading while keeping the shape, so the answer is a half-shaded square.

mcqs.q: Figure analogy — Circle : Cone :: Triangle : ? (2D shape : 3D solid built on that base)
mcqs.explanation: A cone is the 3D solid on a circular base, just as a pyramid is the 3D solid on a triangular base.

mcqs.q: Figure analogy — Pentagon : 5 :: Heptagon : ?
mcqs.explanation: The relationship is "number of sides": a pentagon has 5, so a heptagon has 7.

mcqs.q: Odd figure out: Circle, Square, Triangle, Sphere
mcqs.explanation: Circle, square and triangle are flat (2D) figures; a sphere is a solid (3D) figure, so it is the odd one.

mcqs.q: Odd figure out: Square, Rectangle, Pentagon, Rhombus
mcqs.explanation: Square, rectangle and rhombus are all four-sided (quadrilaterals); a pentagon has five sides.

mcqs.q: Odd figure out (numbers): 121, 144, 169, 200
mcqs.explanation: 121 = 11², 144 = 12², 169 = 13² are perfect squares; 200 is not, so it is the odd one.

mcqs.q: Odd figure out: a triangle, a rectangle, a pentagon, an ellipse
mcqs.explanation: Triangle, rectangle and pentagon are made only of straight lines; the ellipse has a curved boundary.

mcqs.q: Odd one out (numbers): 15, 25, 49, 55
mcqs.explanation: 15, 25 and 55 are all multiples of 5; 49 (7 × 7) is not, so it is the odd one.

mcqs.q: Odd one out (letters): A, E, I, B
mcqs.explanation: A, E and I are vowels; B is a consonant, so it does not belong to the group.

mcqs.q: Which letter's mirror image is DIFFERENT from the letter itself?
mcqs.explanation: A, O and X are symmetric about a vertical axis, so their mirror images look identical; F is not symmetric.

mcqs.q: What is the water image (vertical flip) of the letter "b"?
mcqs.explanation: Flipping b top-to-bottom sends the stem from up to down while the bowl stays on the right, giving p. (Mirror image would give d.)

mcqs.q: A square sheet is folded once vertically down the middle, and a single hole is punched through both layers. How many holes appear when the paper is unfolded?
mcqs.explanation: Two layers were punched, and unfolding mirrors the hole across the fold line — two holes, symmetric about the crease.

mcqs.q: A square sheet is folded once vertically and once horizontally (into quarters), and one hole is punched through all layers. How many holes appear on unfolding?
mcqs.explanation: Four layers were punched; unfolding mirrors the hole across both creases, producing 4 symmetric holes.

mcqs.q: The water image (vertical flip) of the digit "6" closely resembles which digit?
mcqs.explanation: A vertical flip moves the loop from the bottom to the top, turning the shape of 6 into something closely resembling 9.

mcqs.q: Lines drawn from the apex to the base divide a triangle into 3 smaller side-by-side triangles. How many triangles are there in the figure in total?
mcqs.explanation: Count singles (3), adjacent pairs (2) and the whole triangle (1): 3 + 2 + 1 = 6 — the formula n(n+1)/2 for n strips.

mcqs.q: Idiom: 'Bury the hatchet' means:
mcqs.explanation: Bury the hatchet = end conflict; make peace.

mcqs.q: Choose the correct spelling:
mcqs.explanation: 'I before E except after C': receive.

mcqs.q: Idiom: 'Once in a blue moon' means:
mcqs.explanation: Blue moon = rare event; very rarely.

mcqs.q: Choose the synonym of 'Brave':
mcqs.explanation: Brave = courageous, bold, fearless.

mcqs.q: Choose the synonym of 'Cautious':
mcqs.explanation: Cautious = careful, wary, prudent.

mcqs.q: Read the passage: "Remote work has changed Indian offices. Employees save hours of commuting and companies reduce office costs. However, many managers report that new hires learn company culture more slowly when working from home. Most firms now prefer a hybrid model, combining office days with work-from-home days." — According to the passage, what do most firms now prefer?
mcqs.explanation: The last sentence states directly that most firms now prefer a hybrid model combining office days with work-from-home days.

mcqs.q: (Passage on remote work) — Why do some managers hesitate about fully remote arrangements for new hires?
options: New hires learn company culture more slowly at home
mcqs.explanation: The passage says managers report that new hires learn company culture more slowly when working from home.

mcqs.q: Read the passage: "Honeybees communicate the location of food through a waggle dance. The angle of the dance shows the direction of the flowers relative to the sun, while the length of the dance indicates distance. Scientists say this is one of the most complex forms of animal communication." — In the dance, what does the LENGTH of the waggle indicate?
mcqs.explanation: The passage states that the length of the dance indicates distance, while the angle gives direction.

mcqs.q: (Passage on honeybees) — As used in the passage, the word "complex" most nearly means —
mcqs.explanation: "Complex" means having many interrelated parts — closest in meaning to "complicated".

mcqs.q: Read the passage: "The printing press, introduced to India by Jesuit missionaries in the sixteenth century, made books cheaper and more plentiful. Literacy slowly rose, and new ideas travelled faster than ever before. Many historians argue that the press laid the foundation of modern Indian journalism." — Who introduced the printing press to India?
mcqs.explanation: The first sentence states the press was introduced to India by Jesuit missionaries in the sixteenth century.

mcqs.q: (Passage on the printing press) — According to the passage, the printing press laid the foundation of —
mcqs.explanation: The final sentence says many historians argue the press laid the foundation of modern Indian journalism.

mcqs.q: Read the passage: "Planting trees along city roads lowers summer temperatures by several degrees, filters dust from the air, and reduces noise. Yet saplings often die because nobody waters them after the monsoon. Experts suggest that residents 'adopt' roadside trees to ensure regular care." — Why do many roadside saplings die?
options: Nobody waters them after the monsoon
They are planted too close together
mcqs.explanation: The passage says saplings often die because nobody waters them after the monsoon.

mcqs.q: (Passage on urban trees) — What do experts suggest to ensure regular care of roadside trees?
mcqs.explanation: Experts suggest residents "adopt" roadside trees so that someone takes responsibility for regular watering and care.

mcqs.q: Choose the synonym of "Abundant":
mcqs.explanation: Abundant means existing in large quantities — plentiful. "Scarce" is its antonym.

mcqs.q: Choose the synonym of "Diligent":
mcqs.explanation: A diligent person works with steady, careful effort — hardworking.

mcqs.q: Choose the antonym of "Transparent":
mcqs.explanation: Transparent means allowing light through; its opposite is opaque (not allowing light through).

mcqs.q: Choose the antonym of "Expand":
mcqs.explanation: To expand is to grow larger; to contract is to shrink — they are direct opposites.

mcqs.q: One-word substitution: "A person who can speak two languages" is called —
mcqs.explanation: Bilingual = speaking two languages. A linguist studies languages; interpreters/translators convert speech or text professionally.

mcqs.q: One-word substitution: "The life story of a person written by himself/herself" is called —
mcqs.explanation: Auto- means self, so an autobiography is a life story written by its own subject; a biography is written by someone else.

mcqs.q: Idiom: "A blessing in disguise" means —
options: Something that seems bad but turns out good
mcqs.explanation: A blessing in disguise is an apparent misfortune that later proves beneficial — e.g., missing a train that later meets with an accident.

mcqs.q: Idiom: "To beat around the bush" means —
options: To avoid coming to the point
mcqs.explanation: Beating around the bush means talking around a topic and delaying the main point.

mcqs.q: Choose the correctly spelt word (double C, double R):
mcqs.explanation: Correct spelling: occurrence — double C, double R, ends in -ence.

mcqs.q: Which spelling is correct?
mcqs.explanation: Correct spelling: definite (finite inside definite — a useful memory hook).

mcqs.q: Fill in the blank: "By the time we reached the hall, the chief guest ___ his speech."
mcqs.explanation: An action completed before another past action (we reached) takes the past perfect: had finished.

mcqs.q: Fill in the blank: "He is ___ honest officer."
mcqs.explanation: "Honest" begins with a silent h — a vowel sound — so it takes "an": an honest officer.

mcqs.q: Fill in the blank: "She has been working here ___ 2019."
mcqs.explanation: "Since" is used with a point of time (since 2019); "for" is used with a duration (for five years).

mcqs.q: Fill in the blank: "Neither of the answers ___ correct."
mcqs.explanation: "Neither of + plural noun" takes a singular verb: neither of the answers IS correct.

mcqs.q: Fill in the blank: "The number of applicants ___ increasing every year."
mcqs.explanation: "The number of..." is singular ("A number of..." would be plural), so the verb is "is".

mcqs.q: Fill in the blank: "If I ___ you, I would accept the offer."
mcqs.explanation: Unreal conditionals about hypothetical situations use "were" for all persons: If I were you...

mcqs.q: Fill in the blank: "She ___ to Delhi last year."
mcqs.explanation: A finished time marker ("last year") requires the simple past: moved. Present perfect cannot pair with "last year".

mcqs.q: Spot the part containing the error: (A) One of my / (B) friend lives / (C) in Mumbai. / (D) No error
mcqs.explanation: "One of" must be followed by a plural noun: One of my FRIENDS lives in Mumbai. The error is in part (B).

mcqs.q: Fill in the blank: "___ he was ill, he attended the meeting."
mcqs.explanation: The two clauses contrast (ill vs attended), so the concessive conjunction "Although" fits.

mcqs.q: Change to passive voice: "The chef cooks the meal."
options: The meal is cooked by the chef
The meal was cooked by the chef
The meal has cooked by the chef
mcqs.explanation: Simple present passive = is/are + past participle: The meal IS COOKED by the chef.

mcqs.q: Change to indirect speech: He said, "I am tired."
options: He said that he is tired
He said that he was tired
He says that he was tired
He said that I am tired
mcqs.explanation: Reporting verb in the past shifts the tense back: am → was, I → he: He said that he was tired.

mcqs.q: Cloze test — "The exam ___ near, and students ___ their revision seriously. Success ___ those who practise daily." — Blank 1:
mcqs.explanation: "The exam" is singular and the narration is present, so "is approaching" agrees in number and tense.

mcqs.q: (Cloze test) — Blank 2: "students ___ their revision seriously."
mcqs.explanation: "Students" is plural and needs the simple present plural verb: take.

mcqs.q: (Cloze test) — Blank 3: "Success ___ those who practise daily."
mcqs.explanation: "Success" is an uncountable singular subject, so it takes the singular verb "awaits".

mcqs.q: Arrange the sentences in logical order: P: "Finally, the results were announced." Q: "She prepared hard for the competition." R: "She won the first prize." S: "The competition was held in May."
mcqs.explanation: Preparation (Q) → the competition happens (S) → results announced (P) → she wins (R), i.e., Q-S-P-R.

mcqs.q: Arrange the sentences in logical order: P: "It attracts tourists from all over the world." Q: "The Ajanta caves are famous for ancient paintings." R: "These paintings date back to the 2nd century BCE." S: "However, reaching the caves requires a long drive."
mcqs.explanation: Introduction (Q) → detail on the paintings (R) → tourism effect (P) → contrast/caveat with "However" (S): Q-R-P-S.

mcqs.q: Fill in the blank: "The manager's remarks were so ___ that no one could understand his real intention."
mcqs.explanation: If nobody can understand the intention, the remarks must be unclear — vague. "Clear" would contradict the clause.

mcqs.q: एका कंपनीचे उत्पन्न 2020 मध्ये ₹100 कोटी, 2024 मध्ये ₹144 कोटी. वार्षिक वृद्धि दर किती (साधा)?
एका तालिकेत A=20, B=30, C=50. C चे प्रमाण किती टक्के?

mcqs.q: A company's quarterly sales are: Q1 = ₹120 lakh, Q2 = ₹150 lakh, Q3 = ₹180 lakh, Q4 = ₹150 lakh. What is the total annual sales?
mcqs.explanation: 120 + 150 + 180 + 150 = 600. Adding Q2 and Q4 (300) and Q1 and Q3 (300) speeds up the total.

mcqs.q: (Sales data: Q1 = 120, Q2 = 150, Q3 = 180, Q4 = 150, in ₹ lakh) — What is the average quarterly sales?
mcqs.explanation: Total = 600 over 4 quarters, so average = 600/4 = ₹150 lakh.

mcqs.q: (Sales data: Q1 = 120, Q2 = 150, Q3 = 180, Q4 = 150, in ₹ lakh) — What is the percentage increase in sales from Q1 to Q3?
(Sales data: Q1 = 120, Q2 = 150, Q3 = 180, Q4 = 150, in ₹ lakh) — Q2 sales form what percentage of annual sales (₹600 lakh)?
mcqs.explanation: 150/600 × 100 = 25% — a quarter of the year's sales, as expected for an average quarter.

mcqs.q: (Sales data: Q1 = 120, Q2 = 150, Q3 = 180, Q4 = 150, in ₹ lakh) — What is the ratio of Q3 sales to Q2 sales?
mcqs.explanation: 180 : 150 = 18 : 15 = 6 : 5 after dividing both by 30.

mcqs.q: Students enrolled in three courses: Course A = 40, Course B = 60, Course C = 50. What is the total enrolment?
mcqs.explanation: 40 + 60 + 50 = 150 students in total.

mcqs.q: (Course data: A = 40, B = 60, C = 50) — Course B accounts for what percentage of total enrolment?
(Course data: A = 40, B = 60, C = 50) — What is the ratio of Course A students to Course C students?
mcqs.explanation: 40 : 50 simplifies (÷10) to 4 : 5.

mcqs.q: (Course data: A = 40, B = 60, C = 50) — If Course C enrolment grows by 10% next year, what will it become?
(Course data: A = 40, B = 60, C = 50) — What is the average enrolment per course?
mcqs.explanation: Total 150 ÷ 3 courses = 50 students per course on average.

mcqs.q: A factory produced 400 units in 2019 and 500 units in 2020. What is the percentage increase?
mcqs.explanation: (500 − 400)/400 × 100 = 100/400 × 100 = 25%. The base is always the earlier year.

mcqs.q: Production fell from 550 units in 2021 to 495 units in 2022. What is the percentage decrease?
(Production: 2019 = 400, 2021 = 550 units) — What is the ratio of 2019 production to 2021 production?
(Production: 2022 = 495 units) — The 2023 target is 594 units. What percentage increase over 2022 does this represent?
Marks of five students are 45, 55, 65, 75 and 85. What is the average score?
mcqs.explanation: Sum = 325; average = 325/5 = 65. The data is symmetric around 65, so the middle value is the average.

mcqs.q: (Marks: 45, 55, 65, 75, 85) — How many students scored ABOVE the average?
mcqs.explanation: Average = 65; only 75 and 85 exceed it, so 2 students.

mcqs.q: Shop P earned ₹80,000 and Shop Q earned ₹1,20,000 in a month. What is their combined revenue?
(Shop data: P = ₹80,000, Q = ₹1,20,000) — Shop P's revenue is what percentage of the combined revenue?
(Shop data: P = ₹80,000, Q = ₹1,20,000) — By what percentage does Shop Q's revenue exceed Shop P's?
Company employees by department: HR = 12, Finance = 18, IT = 30, Marketing = 20. What is the total workforce?
(Dept data: HR = 12, Finance = 18, IT = 30, Marketing = 20) — What percentage of the workforce is in IT?
(Dept data: HR = 12, Marketing = 20) — What is the ratio of HR employees to Marketing employees?
mcqs.explanation: 12 : 20 = 3 : 5 after dividing both by 4.

mcqs.q: (Dept data: total = 80 across 4 departments) — What is the average number of employees per department?
mcqs.explanation: 80 ÷ 4 = 20 employees per department on average.

mcqs.q: The price of sugar rose from ₹40 per kg to ₹46 per kg. What is the percentage increase?
The price of rice rises by 25%. By what percentage must a family reduce its consumption so that the expenditure stays the same?
A town's population of 25,000 first increases by 10% and then decreases by 10%. What is the final population?
mcqs.explanation: 25,000 × 1.10 × 0.90 = 25,000 × 0.99 = 24,750. A +x% then −x% change always leaves a net decrease.

mcqs.q: A salaried person earns ₹20,000 per month and saves ₹8,000. What percentage of the salary is saved?
The average of 11 results is 50. The average of the first 6 is 49 and of the last 6 is 52. What is the 6th result?
mcqs.explanation: Total = 550; first 6 = 294; last 6 = 312; the 6th result is counted twice: 294 + 312 − 550 = 56.

mcqs.q: A monthly budget of ₹7,200 is split as: rent 40%, food 25%, travel 15%, and the rest is savings. How much money is saved monthly?
In a pie chart of the same budget, travel accounts for 15%. What is the central angle of the travel sector?
mcqs.explanation: Central angle = 15% of 360° = 54°. Shortcut: 1% = 3.6°.

mcqs.q: कथन: 'सर्व विद्यार्थी अभ्यास करतात.' निष्कर्ष: 'काही विद्यार्थी अभ्यास करतात.' निष्कर्ष वैध आहे का?
mcqs.explanation: 'सर्व' म्हणजे 'काही' समाविष्ट; निष्कर्ष वैध.

mcqs.q: कथन: 'जर पाऊस पडला तर ओले होईल.' कारण-परिणाम:
mcqs.explanation: पाऊस (कारण) → ओले (परिणाम).

mcqs.q: कथन: 'शहरात प्रदूषण वाढले आहे.' कृती: 'वृक्ष लावावेत.' कृती योग्य आहे का?
mcqs.explanation: वृक्ष प्रदूषण कमी करतात — कृती योग्य.

mcqs.q: Statement: "The school has announced special Saturday classes for all Class 10 students." An implicit assumption in the statement is —
options: Class 10 students will be able to attend classes on Saturdays
Saturday classes will be free of charge
The school will be closed on Saturdays
mcqs.explanation: The announcement is meaningful only if the targeted students can actually attend on Saturdays; that ability is assumed, not stated.

mcqs.q: Statement: "'Buy two, get one absolutely free' — the new offer at Mega Mart." The offer assumes that —
options: the store is running at a loss
customers are attracted by free items and discounts
goods at Mega Mart are defective
mcqs.explanation: Such offers are designed assuming buyers respond to savings; hence the implicit assumption is that customers are attracted by free items and discounts.

mcqs.q: Statement: "Advertisement: 'Use Sparkle toothpaste for stronger, cavity-free teeth.'" The advertisement assumes that —
mcqs.explanation: An appeal to "cavity-free teeth" works only if the audience desires that benefit, which is the unstated assumption.

mcqs.q: Statement: "The municipal corporation urged citizens to use public transport to reduce traffic congestion." The appeal assumes that —
options: citizens are willing and able to use public transport
public transport is costlier than cars
citizens do not own any vehicles
mcqs.explanation: The appeal presumes citizens can shift to public transport; without that assumption the request would be pointless.

mcqs.q: Statement: "'Admissions are accepted online only; there is no spot admission' — a coaching institute's notice." The notice assumes that —
options: online admission is free of cost
applicants can access and use the online system
spot admissions are banned by law
the institute has no office staff
mcqs.explanation: Restricting admission to online mode presumes that applicants have internet access and can complete the process online.

mcqs.q: Statement: "A signboard near a freshly painted bench reads, 'Wet paint — do not touch.'" The sign assumes that —
options: people might touch the bench unless warned
mcqs.explanation: A warning is put up because the painter assumes some people would otherwise touch the wet bench.

mcqs.q: Statement: "Sales of electric scooters in the city rose by 40% this year, while petrol scooter sales fell by 10%." Which conclusion can be drawn?
options: Many buyers are shifting from petrol to electric scooters
Petrol scooters will be banned next year
Electric scooters are cheaper than bicycles
No one buys petrol scooters any more
mcqs.explanation: Rising electric sales alongside falling petrol sales reasonably suggests a shift in buyer preference; the other options exaggerate or add unstated facts.

mcqs.q: Statement: "In a college survey, 70% of the students said they prefer online mock tests to paper-based tests." Which conclusion follows?
options: All students prefer online mock tests
A majority of the surveyed students favour online mock tests
mcqs.explanation: 70% is a majority, so "a majority of the surveyed students favour online mock tests" follows; nothing is said about quality or failure.

mcqs.q: Statement: "The college library stays open till 10 pm during examination weeks but closes at 6 pm otherwise." Which conclusion follows?
options: The library extends its timings during examinations
The library has no staff on exam days
mcqs.explanation: Closing at 10 pm instead of 6 pm during exams directly means extended hours in examination weeks.

mcqs.q: Statement: "Ravi scored the highest marks in Quantitative Aptitude in his batch." Which conclusion does NOT follow?
options: Ravi did well in Quantitative Aptitude
No batchmate outscored Ravi in Quantitative Aptitude
Ravi is the best student in every subject
Ravi topped his batch in Quantitative Aptitude
mcqs.explanation: Being best in Quant does not imply being best in every subject — that over-generalisation does not follow; the rest simply restate the statement.

mcqs.q: Statement: "A study found that employees who eat breakfast make fewer errors at work." Which of the following strengthens the finding?
options: Some employees skip lunch as well
Errors at work are always costly
The study compared employees of similar age, sleep and workload
mcqs.explanation: If other factors (sleep, workload, age) were held equal, the error difference can be more confidently linked to breakfast — that strengthens the causal claim.

mcqs.q: Statement: "The principal claims that online recorded lectures have improved class attendance." Which fact supports the claim?
options: Attendance figures have risen steadily since the lectures were recorded
mcqs.explanation: A rise in attendance exactly after the change provides direct supporting evidence for the principal's claim.

mcqs.q: Statement: "A chocolate company claims its bar is healthy because it contains nuts." Which of the following weakens the claim?
options: The same bar contains a very high amount of sugar
mcqs.explanation: High sugar content directly undermines the "healthy" claim, even if nuts are present.

mcqs.q: Statement: "The principal said, 'Installing CCTV cameras in corridors will stop students from bunking classes.'" Which of the following weakens the principal's argument?
options: CCTV cameras are costly to maintain
Students can bunk in places not covered by the cameras
Teachers also walk in the corridors
mcqs.explanation: If students can simply bunk elsewhere, CCTV in corridors will not stop bunking — this directly weakens the argument.

mcqs.q: Statement: "Sales fell in the month after a new advertisement campaign; the manager says the campaign caused the fall." Which of the following weakens the manager's claim?
options: The whole industry saw a similar fall because of a recession
mcqs.explanation: An industry-wide recession offers an alternative explanation for the fall, weakening the claim that the campaign was the cause.

mcqs.q: Statement: "Continuous heavy rain for three days has left many low-lying roads waterlogged." Courses of action: I. The civic body should deploy pumps to drain the water quickly. II. All schools in the city should be closed permanently.
mcqs.explanation: Deploying pumps is a practical, immediate remedy; permanently closing schools is an extreme, unjustified step.

mcqs.q: Statement: "Many employees complain of eye strain after long hours before computer screens." Courses of action: I. The company should advise short, regular screen breaks. II. The company should organise periodic eye check-up camps.
mcqs.explanation: Both actions are reasonable, practical steps to address the stated problem, so both follow.

mcqs.q: Statement: "City buses are badly overcrowded during peak hours." Courses of action: I. Bus services should be stopped during peak hours so that nobody is overcrowded. II. Passengers should be prohibited from boarding buses.
mcqs.explanation: Stopping services or banning boarding would punish commuters instead of solving overcrowding; neither is a sensible course of action.

mcqs.q: Statement: "Power cuts have become frequent in the industrial area of the city." Courses of action: I. The electricity board should repair and upgrade the old transformers. II. Industries should be encouraged to install backup power units.
mcqs.explanation: Fixing the root cause (old transformers) and providing industries a backup buffer are both valid, complementary actions.

mcqs.q: Statement: "Vehicles parked near a hospital gate are blocking the path of ambulances." Courses of action: I. Traffic police should tow away and fine wrongly parked vehicles. II. The hospital should be shifted to another city.
mcqs.explanation: Enforcing no-parking directly clears the ambulance path; shifting an entire hospital is absurdly disproportionate.

mcqs.q: Statement: "Water supply in the colony is irregular and unpredictable." Courses of action: I. Residents should install large water purifiers to solve the problem. II. The water department should announce a fixed supply schedule and repair leakages.
mcqs.explanation: Purifiers clean water but do nothing about irregularity; a fixed schedule and leak repairs address the actual problem, so only II follows.

mcqs.q: Statement: "Incidents of chain snatching have increased in the crowded market area." Courses of action: I. Police should intensify patrolling in the market area. II. The market should be closed down permanently.
mcqs.explanation: More patrolling is a proportionate response to rising snatching; permanently closing a market punishes traders and shoppers, not criminals.

mcqs.q: Statement: "All employees who complete the training programme receive a certificate." Conclusions: I. Ravi received a certificate. II. Ravi completed the training programme.
mcqs.explanation: The statement gives a rule, but nothing tells us whether Ravi completed the training or received a certificate — neither conclusion follows.

mcqs.q: Statement: "Some managers are good communicators, and all good communicators are good listeners." Conclusions: I. Some managers are good listeners. II. All managers are good listeners.
mcqs.explanation: The managers who are good communicators must be good listeners, so some managers are good listeners; extending this to ALL managers is invalid.

mcqs.q: Statement: "No student is issued a grade-sheet without internal assessment marks." Conclusions: I. Internal assessment marks are necessary for a grade-sheet. II. Every student who has internal marks gets a grade-sheet.
mcqs.explanation: Without internal marks no grade-sheet is issued, so internal marks are necessary; but other requirements may also exist, so II (sufficiency) does not follow.

mcqs.q: Statement: "The train to Nagpur leaves only after 8 pm." Conclusions: I. There is no train to Nagpur before 8 pm. II. Trains to other cities also leave only after 8 pm.
mcqs.explanation: "Leaves only after 8 pm" rules out any Nagpur train before 8 pm (I follows); nothing is said about trains to other cities (II does not follow).

mcqs.q: Statement A: "The price of tomatoes doubled within a week." Statement B: "The demand for alternative vegetables increased sharply."
options: A is the cause and B is its effect
B is the cause and A is its effect
Both A and B are independent causes
Both A and B are effects of a common cause
mcqs.explanation: When a vegetable becomes costly, buyers switch to substitutes — so the price rise (A) causes the higher demand for alternatives (B).

mcqs.q: Statement A: "Mobile phone users in the village grew rapidly." Statement B: "The village got its first mobile tower last year."
options: A is the cause and B is its effect
B is the cause and A is its effect
Both A and B are independent causes
Both A and B are effects of a common cause
mcqs.explanation: Network coverage (the tower, B) makes phones useful, which drives user growth (A); hence B is the cause and A the effect.

mcqs.q: Statement A: "The admission fees of private colleges increased sharply this year." Statement B: "Enrolment in government colleges rose this year."
options: A is the cause and B is its effect
B is the cause and A is its effect
Both A and B are independent causes
Both A and B are effects of a common cause
mcqs.explanation: Costlier private admission naturally pushes cost-conscious students towards government colleges, so A causes B.

mcqs.q: Statement A: "India won the final match on Sunday." Statement B: "The price of gold rose in the international market on Monday."
options: A is the cause and B is its effect
B is the cause and A is its effect
Both A and B are independent causes
Both A and B are effects of a common cause
mcqs.explanation: A cricket result and international gold prices operate in unrelated spheres; mere time sequence does not establish causation.

mcqs.q: Statement: "Should college canteens switch to a healthier menu?" Argument I: "Yes, nutritious food improves students' health and concentration." Argument II: "No, canteens have always sold the same food."
mcqs.explanation: I gives a substantive benefit (health, concentration); II appeals only to habit, which is a weak argument.

mcqs.q: Statement: "Should the university conduct its semester exams online?" Argument I: "Yes, online exams save paper and allow faster result processing." Argument II: "No, it is harder to monitor students for unfair means in online exams."
mcqs.explanation: I cites genuine benefits while II raises a real exam-integrity concern; both are relevant, so both are strong.

mcqs.q: Statement: "Should mobile phones be banned in classrooms?" Argument I: "Yes, phones frequently distract students during lectures." Argument II: "No, phones can be useful for quick academic research."
mcqs.explanation: Distraction is a valid ground for a ban, and academic utility is a valid ground against it — both arguments are strong.

mcqs.q: Statement: "'Hurry! Limited seats only' — the closing line of an institute's advertisement." The line assumes that —
options: a sense of urgency will prompt early admissions
the institute is about to shut down
mcqs.explanation: Scarcity messaging is used precisely because urgency is assumed to push prospective students to enrol quickly.

mcqs.q: Statement: "'Join our weekend batch, designed especially for working professionals.'" The statement assumes that —
options: some working professionals wish to attend such batches
mcqs.explanation: Creating a weekend batch for professionals presumes there is demand for it among them; the other options are extreme or irrelevant.

mcqs.q: Statement: "The college attributes its improved placement record to the new interview-training module." Which of the following supports the claim?
options: Placement results vary from year to year
The college was established decades ago
Colleges that adopted similar modules also reported better placements
mcqs.explanation: Similar results at other colleges using the module provide corroborating evidence that the training caused the improvement.

mcqs.q: Statement: "A gym claims its new diet plan causes weight loss, noting that many members lost weight within a month." Which of the following weakens the claim?
options: Members also started daily workouts when they joined
mcqs.explanation: If members were simultaneously exercising daily, the workouts offer an alternative cause of the weight loss, weakening the diet-plan claim.

mcqs.q: Statement: "Of 100 students who appeared for both tests, 80 cleared Test A but only 40 cleared Test B." Which inference is valid?
options: Test B appears harder to clear than Test A
Test B was not conducted properly
mcqs.explanation: A much lower pass rate on Test B suggests it is harder to clear; the other options contradict or go beyond the data.

mcqs.q: Statement: "Most employees of the office use the canteen daily." Which conclusion follows?
options: Some employees of the office use the canteen daily
mcqs.explanation: "Most" means more than half, which certainly implies "some" use it daily; "all" goes beyond what is stated.

mcqs.q: Statement: "The new app-based attendance system reduced late arrivals by half within a month." Which conclusion follows?
options: Late arrivals decreased after the new system was introduced
Late arrivals will become zero next month
mcqs.explanation: A reduction by half directly means late arrivals decreased after introduction; predictions and preferences go beyond the data.

mcqs.q: एका त्रिकोणाची दोन बाजू 3 व 4 सेमी आहेत (काटकोन). कर्ण किती?
एका वर्तुळाची त्रिज्या 5 सेमी. परिघ किती? (π=3.14)
एका चौरसाची बाजू 6 सेमी. कर्ण किती?
एका आयताची लांबी 8 व रुंदी 6 सेमी. कर्ण किती?
एका समभुज त्रिकोणाची बाजू 6 सेमी. क्षेत्रफळ किती? (√3=1.732)
एका घनाची बाजू 4 सेमी. आयतन किती?
mcqs.explanation: V = a³ = 4³ = 64 cm³.

mcqs.q: एका सिलेंडरची त्रिज्या 3 सेमी व उंची 5 सेमी. आयतन किती? (π=22/7)
एका चौरसाचे क्षेत्रफळ 81 cm² आहे. परिमिती किती?
एका शंकूची त्रिज्या 3 व उंची 4 सेमी. तिरपी उंची किती?
एका आयताची लांबी 10 व रुंदी 5 सेमी. क्षेत्रफळ किती?
एका त्रिकोणाचा पाय 8 व उंची 5 सेमी. क्षेत्रफळ किती?
एका घनाचे एकूण पृष्ठफळ 96 cm² आहे. बाजू किती?
एका आयताची परिमिती 20 सेमी व लांबी 6 सेमी. रुंदी किती?
A right-angled triangle has legs of 5 cm and 12 cm. What is the length of its hypotenuse?
mcqs.explanation: By Pythagoras: √(5² + 12²) = √(25 + 144) = √169 = 13 cm. (5-12-13 is a standard triple.)

mcqs.q: The hypotenuse of a right triangle is 13 cm and one leg is 5 cm. What is the other leg?
mcqs.explanation: Other leg = √(13² − 5²) = √(169 − 25) = √144 = 12 cm — reverse use of the 5-12-13 triple.

mcqs.q: An isosceles right triangle has two equal sides of 6 cm each. What is its hypotenuse?
mcqs.explanation: Hypotenuse = side × √2 = 6√2 cm, since √(6² + 6²) = √72 = 6√2.

mcqs.q: Find the area of a triangle with base 12 cm and height 7 cm.
mcqs.explanation: Area = ½ × base × height = ½ × 12 × 7 = 42 cm². Forgetting the ½ gives the common wrong answer 84.

mcqs.q: The area of a triangle is 60 cm² and its base is 15 cm. What is its height?
What is the height of an equilateral triangle of side 8 cm? (√3 = 1.732)
The perimeter of an equilateral triangle is 48 cm. Its area is —
The circumference of a circle is 44 cm. What is its area? (π = 22/7)
The area of a circle is 616 cm². What is its radius? (π = 22/7)
A wheel of diameter 70 cm makes how many revolutions to cover 1.1 km? (π = 22/7)
What is the perimeter of a semicircle of radius 7 cm? (π = 22/7)
mcqs.explanation: Perimeter = πr + 2r = 22 + 14 = 36 cm — remember the semicircle includes the diameter.

mcqs.q: A rectangle has length 12 cm and area 96 cm². What is its perimeter?
mcqs.explanation: Width = 96/12 = 8 cm; perimeter = 2(12 + 8) = 40 cm.

mcqs.q: The diagonal of a square is 8√2 cm. What is its area?
mcqs.explanation: Diagonal = side√2 ⇒ side = 8 cm; area = 8² = 64 cm². (Also: area = diagonal²/2 = 128/2 = 64.)

mcqs.q: Find the cost of fencing a square field of side 25 m at ₹12 per metre.
The perimeter of a rectangle is 46 cm and its length is 14 cm. What is its area?
mcqs.explanation: Length + width = 46/2 = 23 ⇒ width = 9 cm; area = 14 × 9 = 126 cm².

mcqs.q: Find the area of a parallelogram with base 10 cm and height 6 cm.
mcqs.explanation: Area of a parallelogram = base × height = 10 × 6 = 60 cm².

mcqs.q: A trapezium has parallel sides of 10 cm and 14 cm, and the distance between them is 6 cm. Its area is —
mcqs.explanation: Area = ½ × (sum of parallel sides) × height = ½ × 24 × 6 = 72 cm².

mcqs.q: The diagonals of a rhombus are 10 cm and 24 cm. What is its perimeter?
mcqs.explanation: Half-diagonals 5 and 12 form a right triangle, so side = √(25 + 144) = 13 cm; perimeter = 4 × 13 = 52 cm.

mcqs.q: What is the total surface area of a cube of edge 5 cm?
mcqs.explanation: TSA of a cube = 6a² = 6 × 25 = 150 cm². (125 is the volume, a common trap.)

mcqs.q: The volume of a cube is 343 cm³. What is its total surface area?
Find the total surface area of a cuboid of dimensions 8 cm × 6 cm × 4 cm.
What is the length of the diagonal of a cuboid measuring 10 cm × 8 cm × 6 cm?
Find the volume of a cylinder of radius 7 cm and height 10 cm. (π = 22/7)
The curved surface area of a cylinder is 264 cm² and its radius is 7 cm. What is its height? (π = 22/7)
A cone has radius 7 cm and height 24 cm. What is its curved surface area? (π = 22/7)
mcqs.explanation: Slant height l = √(49 + 576) = 25 cm; CSA = πrl = (22/7) × 7 × 25 = 550 cm².

mcqs.q: Find the volume of a cone of radius 3 cm and height 7 cm. (π = 22/7)
mcqs.explanation: Volume = (1/3)πr²h = (1/3) × (22/7) × 9 × 7 = 66 cm³ — one-third of the matching cylinder.

mcqs.q: What is the total surface area of a sphere of radius 14 cm? (π = 22/7)
A solid metallic sphere of radius 6 cm is melted and recast into a cylinder of radius 3 cm. What is the height of the cylinder?
mcqs.explanation: Equate volumes: (4/3)π(6³) = π(3²)h ⇒ 288π = 9πh ⇒ h = 32 cm.

mcqs.q: The radii of two spheres are in the ratio 2 : 3. What is the ratio of their volumes?
mcqs.explanation: Volumes scale as the cube of the radius: 2³ : 3³ = 8 : 27.

mcqs.q: What is the total surface area of a solid hemisphere of radius 7 cm? (π = 22/7)
mcqs.explanation: TSA of a solid hemisphere = 3πr² = 3 × (22/7) × 49 = 3 × 154 = 462 cm² (curved + flat circular face).

mcqs.q: 2x + 3 = 11 समीकरण सोडवा. x = ?
x² - 5x + 6 = 0 समीकरणाची मुळे काय?
(a+b)² चे मूल्य काय?
mcqs.explanation: (a+b)² = a² + 2ab + b².

mcqs.q: log₂ 8 चे मूल्य किती?
5! चे मूल्य किती?
¹⁰C₂ चे मूल्य किती?
¹⁰P₂ चे मूल्य किती?
x + y = 10 आणि x - y = 4 असल्यास x चे मूल्य किती?
mcqs.explanation: एकत्र केल्यास 2x = 14 ⇒ x = 7.

mcqs.q: 3x² - 12 = 0 समीकरण सोडवा. x = ?
a=2, b=3 असल्यास (a+b)² चे मूल्य किती?
Solve for x: 3x − 7 = 14.
In how many ways can a committee of 2 people be selected from a group of 8 people?
mcqs.explanation: ⁸C₂ = (8 × 7)/2 = 28. Selection (order irrelevant) uses combinations, not permutations.

mcqs.q: If 2x + y = 11 and x − y = 1, what is the value of xy?
mcqs.explanation: Adding gives 3x = 12 ⇒ x = 4, y = 3; so xy = 12.

mcqs.q: The sum of two numbers is 25 and their difference is 7. What is their product?
mcqs.explanation: Numbers = (25 ± 7)/2 = 16 and 9; product = 16 × 9 = 144.

mcqs.q: What are the roots of x² − 7x + 12 = 0?
mcqs.explanation: Factorise: (x − 3)(x − 4) = 0 ⇒ x = 3, 4. Check: sum 7, product 12. ✓

mcqs.q: The roots of 2x² − 5x − 3 = 0 are —
mcqs.explanation: Discriminant = 25 + 24 = 49 ⇒ x = (5 ± 7)/4, giving 3 and −1/2.

mcqs.q: For what value(s) of k does x² + kx + 9 = 0 have equal roots?
mcqs.explanation: Equal roots ⇒ discriminant k² − 36 = 0 ⇒ k = ±6.

mcqs.q: If −3 < 2x + 1 < 7, then x lies in the interval —
mcqs.explanation: Subtract 1 throughout: −4 < 2x < 6; divide by 2: −2 < x < 3 (strict inequalities remain strict).

mcqs.q: How many integers satisfy the condition −2 ≤ x < 3?
mcqs.explanation: The integers are −2, −1, 0, 1, 2 — five values (3 itself is excluded).

mcqs.q: Simplify: (2³ × 2⁵) ÷ 2⁶.
mcqs.explanation: Add indices on multiplication, subtract on division: 2^(3+5−6) = 2² = 4.

mcqs.q: Simplify: (3⁴)² ÷ 3⁶.
If 2^x = 32, what is the value of x?
Simplify: √50 + √8.
mcqs.explanation: √50 = 5√2 and √8 = 2√2, so the sum is 7√2. (√58 ignores the simplification — a common trap.)

mcqs.q: Simplify: √12 × √3.
Rationalise the denominator: 1/(√3 − 1).
mcqs.explanation: Multiply by (√3 + 1)/(√3 + 1): the denominator becomes 3 − 1 = 2, giving (√3 + 1)/2.

mcqs.q: Which of the following numbers is exactly divisible by 9?
mcqs.explanation: Digit sums: 5670 → 18 (divisible by 9); 1234 → 10, 4567 → 22, 2345 → 14 — none works.

mcqs.q: What is the remainder when 2¹⁰ is divided by 5?
mcqs.explanation: 2¹⁰ = 1024 = 5 × 204 + 4, so the remainder is 4.

mcqs.q: What is the remainder when 3⁵ is divided by 7?
mcqs.explanation: 3⁵ = 243 = 7 × 34 + 5, so the remainder is 5.

mcqs.q: What is the unit digit of 3³⁴?
mcqs.explanation: Unit digits of powers of 3 cycle 3, 9, 7, 1 (period 4); 34 mod 4 = 2, so the 2nd term — 9 — is the unit digit.

mcqs.q: What is the unit digit of 13 × 27 × 46?
mcqs.explanation: Only unit digits matter: 3 × 7 × 6 = 126 ⇒ unit digit 6.

mcqs.q: What is the unit digit of 4⁵⁵?
mcqs.explanation: Powers of 4 alternate 4, 6 (odd power → 4, even → 6); 55 is odd, so the unit digit is 4.

mcqs.q: How many prime numbers lie between 50 and 60?
mcqs.explanation: Only 53 and 59 are prime (51 = 3 × 17, 57 = 3 × 19).

mcqs.q: Which of the following is a prime number?
What is the sum of the first 20 natural numbers?
Find the 10th term of the arithmetic progression 7, 11, 15, ...
What is the sum of the first 15 odd natural numbers?
mcqs.explanation: The sum of the first n odd numbers is n²; 15² = 225.

mcqs.q: Find the 5th term of the GP with first term 2 and common ratio 3.
If x − 1/x = 4, what is the value of x² + 1/x²?
mcqs.explanation: x² + 1/x² = (x − 1/x)² + 2 = 16 + 2 = 18 (note the +2 because of the minus identity).

mcqs.q: If a + b = 7 and ab = 10, what is the value of a² + b²?
What is the value of log₃ 81?
mcqs.explanation: 81 = 3⁴, so log₃ 81 = 4.

chapters.title: MBA CET — Practice Mock Tips & Strategy

mcqs.q: MBA CET मध्ये कोणता विभाग प्रथम सोडवावा?
mcqs.explanation: अमूर्त तर्क (AR) — सोपा व जलद; 25 प्रश्न 15-20 मिनिटांत पूर्ण.

mcqs.q: MBA CET मध्ये कठीण प्रश्न आढळल्यास काय करावे?
mcqs.explanation: कठीण प्रश्न सोडून पुढे जा — शेवटी परत ये; वेळ वाचवा.

mcqs.q: MBA CET मध्ये शेवटची 5 मिनिटे कशी वापरावीत?
mcqs.explanation: शेवटच्या 5 मिनिटांत सर्व रिकामी उत्तरे भरा — कोणतेही नुकसान नाही (नो नेगेटिव्ह मार्किंग).

mcqs.q: MBA CET च्या तयारीसाठी कोणते वृत्तपत्र वाचावे?
mcqs.explanation: The Hindu (RC सराव), Economic Times (व्यवसाय शब्दसंग्रह), TOI (सामान्य वाचन).

mcqs.q: MBA CET मध्ये RC उतारा निवडताना काय लक्षात घ्यावे?
mcqs.explanation: सोपे व शॉर्ट उतारे आधी निवडा — कमी वेळात अधिक प्रश्न.

mcqs.q: MBA CET च्या तयारीसाठी किती मॉक टेस्ट घ्याव्यात?
mcqs.explanation: कमीत कमी 30-40 मॉक टेस्ट — वेळ व्यवस्थापन व नमुना समज हेतु.

mcqs.q: MBA CET मध्ये किती प्रश्न सोडवणे योग्य आहे (योग्य उत्तरासाठी)?
mcqs.explanation: उच्च टक्केवारी (99+) हेतु 180+ प्रश्न सोडवा; सर्व 200 प्रश्न भरा (नो नेगेटिव्ह मार्किंग).

mcqs.q: MBA CET च्या तयारीसाठी किती तास अभ्यास आवश्यक?
mcqs.explanation: दररोज 4-6 तास अभ्यास — सराव, मॉक, वाचन यांचे मिश्रण.

mcqs.q: MBA CET मध्ये बैठक व्यवस्था प्रश्न कसे सोडवावेत?
mcqs.explanation: बैठक व्यवस्था संच पूर्ण करा — एकदा आकृती तयार झाल्यावर 5-10 प्रश्न एकत्र सोडवता येतात.

mcqs.q: MBA CET परीक्षेसाठी कोणती भाषा शिकावी (शब्दसंग्रह)?
mcqs.explanation: इंग्रजी शब्दसंग्रह — MBA CET इंग्रजीत आहे; Word Power Made Easy (Norman Lewis) वाचा.

mcqs.q: MBA CET मध्ये DI प्रश्न कसे सोडवावेत?
options: अचूक वाचन व गणना — वेळेत जलद
mcqs.explanation: DI — आलेख अचूक वाचा; गणना जलद करा; सरळ सूत्रे लक्षात ठेवा.

mcqs.q: MBA CET च्या तयारीसाठी ऑनलाइन साधने कोणती?
options: Career Launcher, TIME, IMS ऑनलाइन मॉक
mcqs.explanation: Career Launcher, TIME, IMS ऑनलाइन मॉक टेस्ट श्रृंखला — वेळ व्यवस्थापन व विश्लेषण हेतु.

mcqs.q: MBA CET च्या दिवशी काय करावे?
options: शांत राहा, वेळेत पोहोच, सर्व कागदपत्रे घेऊन
mcqs.explanation: शांत राहा; वेळेत पोहोच; आधार कार्ड, प्रवेशपत्र, फोटो घेऊन जा.

mcqs.q: How many questions does the MAH-MBA/MMS CET paper contain in total?
mcqs.explanation: The paper has 200 questions spread over four sections (QA 50, LR 75, AR 25, VARC 50).

mcqs.q: What is the total time duration of the MAH-MBA CET examination?
mcqs.explanation: MAH-MBA CET lasts 150 minutes (2.5 hours) with no sectional time limits.
