mcqs.q: With 200 questions in 150 minutes, what should be your average pace per question?
mcqs.explanation: 150 × 60 ÷ 200 = 45 seconds per question on average — plan faster on easy items to bank time for sets.

mcqs.q: Which section of MAH-MBA CET carries the highest weightage in terms of number of questions?
mcqs.explanation: Logical Reasoning has 75 of the 200 questions — the single largest section.

mcqs.q: How many questions does the Abstract Reasoning section contain in MAH-MBA CET?
mcqs.explanation: Abstract Reasoning carries 25 questions, typically the fastest section to complete.

mcqs.q: How many questions does the Verbal Ability & Reading Comprehension (VARC) section contain?
mcqs.explanation: VARC carries 50 questions — 25% of the paper.

mcqs.q: Why is Abstract Reasoning usually attempted first in MAH-MBA CET?
options: its questions are short and can be scored quickly
it is the only scored section
it needs no reading at all
mcqs.explanation: AR items are brief visual puzzles; finishing 25 of them in 15-20 minutes builds early marks and confidence.

mcqs.q: MAH-MBA CET has no negative marking. What is the optimal guessing policy?
options: guess only in the VARC section
answer every question before final submission
skip half the paper to stay safe
mcqs.explanation: With zero penalty for wrong answers, every blank question is a lost mark — fill in all answers before time ends.

mcqs.q: A candidate attempts 140 questions with 90% accuracy (1 mark each, no negative marking). What is the score?
A candidate allocates 45 of the 150 minutes to Quantitative Aptitude. What fraction of the total exam time is this?
mcqs.explanation: 45/150 × 100 = 30% — a sensible QA allocation close to its 25% question share.

mcqs.q: What is the most productive step immediately AFTER taking a mock test?
options: analyse mistakes and revise the weak areas
mcqs.explanation: Reviewing every error and concept gap converts a mock into learning; score-tracking alone adds nothing.

mcqs.q: What should be the focus in the LAST WEEK before MAH-MBA CET?
options: revise formulas and take light mocks
mcqs.explanation: The final week is for consolidation — formula sheets, weak-area revision and 1-2 light mocks; new topics only add anxiety.

mcqs.q: You are stuck on a very long Logical Reasoning puzzle set after 2 minutes. What is the best move?
options: mark it for review and move ahead
mcqs.explanation: Mark-for-review protects your time budget; return later if minutes remain after clearing easier questions.

mcqs.q: Reading newspaper editorials for 30 minutes daily mainly improves which exam skill?
mcqs.explanation: Dense editorial prose trains faster reading and better comprehension — exactly what RC and verbal questions demand.

mcqs.q: What is the recommended way to build vocabulary for VARC?
options: read the dictionary once cover to cover
mcqs.explanation: Spaced daily learning of 10-15 words with periodic revision beats one-day cramming, which fades within days.

mcqs.q: Why can the VARC section usually be finished faster than QA in MAH-MBA CET?
options: many vocab/grammar items take under 30 seconds each
mcqs.explanation: A large share of VARC consists of quick vocabulary, grammar and usage items that can be answered in under 30 seconds.

mcqs.q: In the computer-based CET, where is rough work done?
options: on blank sheets provided at the centre
mcqs.explanation: The centre provides sanctioned rough sheets/Booklet for calculations; using anything else can invite disqualification.

mcqs.q: Are calculators allowed in MAH-MBA CET?
mcqs.explanation: No calculator is permitted, which is why mental maths and fraction-percentage shortcuts matter so much.

mcqs.q: Which mental-maths skill gives the biggest speed boost in DI questions?
mcqs.explanation: Converting fractions to percentages instantly (1/8 = 12.5%, 1/6 ≈ 16.67%) avoids long divisions in DI.

mcqs.q: What should be the FIRST step when you open a Data Interpretation set?
options: read the title, units and footnotes carefully
look only at the largest value
mcqs.explanation: Titles, units (thousands vs lakhs) and footnotes decide what the numbers mean — misreading them wrecks every question in the set.

mcqs.q: What is the fastest reliable method for syllogism questions?
mcqs.explanation: A 10-second Venn diagram settles "follows/does not follow" far more reliably than mental reasoning.

mcqs.q: When starting a seating-arrangement puzzle, which clue should you use first?
options: the most definite clue (fixed position/facing) and build around it
mcqs.explanation: Anchoring with a fixed clue creates a frame; all relative clues then attach around it quickly.

mcqs.q: What accuracy should you target on the questions you attempt in MAH-MBA CET?
options: as high as possible, ideally 85-90%+ on attempts
mcqs.explanation: Since every attempt is a chance at +1, high accuracy on selected questions outperforms careless mass-attempting.

mcqs.q: A candidate scores in the 95th percentile. What does this mean?
options: scored better than about 95% of the candidates
mcqs.explanation: Percentile compares you with other test-takers: 95th percentile means roughly the top 5% of candidates.

mcqs.q: At a steady rate of 1 question per minute, how many questions can a candidate attempt in the full 150-minute paper?
mcqs.explanation: 150 minutes × 1 question/minute = 150 attempts — still 50 short of the paper, showing why speed practice matters.

mcqs.q: A candidate finishes the 25 Abstract Reasoning questions in 20 minutes of a 150-minute paper. How much time remains for the other 175 questions?
mcqs.explanation: 150 − 20 = 130 minutes left — about 44 seconds per remaining question.

mcqs.q: How should you spend the night before the CET exam?
options: 3-4 hours of sleep after last-minute cramming
mcqs.explanation: A rested brain solves 45-second-per-question puzzles far better than a crammed, exhausted one — sleep is part of the strategy.

mcqs.q: When should you reach the exam centre on CET day?
options: arrive exactly when the exam starts
reach a day in advance and wait
follow the admit-card reporting time and reach early
mcqs.explanation: Biometrics, frisking and document checks take time; the admit card states the reporting time — respect it with a buffer.

mcqs.q: What is the best use of the first few minutes after the CET test begins?
mcqs.explanation: A quick read of on-screen instructions (navigation, marking, review) prevents costly interface errors later.

mcqs.q: Two options both look plausible in a verbal question. What is the best tie-breaking strategy?
options: eliminate clearly wrong ones and choose the option closest to the passage
choose an option with an unfamiliar word
mcqs.explanation: Elimination plus "closest to the passage/context" is the standard CET tie-breaker; length and position mean nothing.

chapters.title: MBA CET Mock Test 1 — Full Practice

mcqs.q: QA: एक रेल्वे 360 मीटर प्लॅटफॉर्म 18 सेकंदांत पार करते. वेग km/h?
A shopkeeper buys an article for ₹450 and sells it for ₹495. What is his profit percentage?
If 15 workers can build a wall in 48 hours, how many workers are needed to build it in 30 hours?
mcqs.explanation: Total work = 15 × 48 = 720 worker-hours; workers needed = 720/30 = 24 (inverse proportion).

mcqs.q: Find the simple interest on ₹6,500 at 8% per annum for 2.5 years.
A train 150 m long crosses a pole in 12 seconds. What is its speed in km/h?
The average of 6 numbers is 18. If a 7th number is added, the average becomes 20. What is the 7th number?
mcqs.explanation: New total = 7 × 20 = 140; old total = 108; 7th number = 140 − 108 = 32.

mcqs.q: Two numbers are in the ratio 5 : 7 and their LCM is 140. What is the smaller number?
mcqs.explanation: Numbers are 5x and 7x with LCM 35x = 140 ⇒ x = 4; smaller number = 5 × 4 = 20.

mcqs.q: 25% of a number is 60. What is 40% of the same number?
A can finish a task in 12 days and B in 18 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
mcqs.explanation: Combined rate = 1/12 + 1/18 = 5/36 per day ⇒ time = 36/5 = 7.2 days.

mcqs.q: Find the compound interest on ₹4,000 at 10% per annum for 2 years.
A car covers 180 km in 2.5 hours. What is its average speed?
The perimeter of a rectangle is 44 cm and its length exceeds its width by 2 cm. What is its area?
mcqs.explanation: l + w = 22 and l − w = 2 ⇒ l = 12, w = 10; area = 120 cm².

mcqs.q: What is the remainder when 586 is divided by 9?
mcqs.explanation: Digit sum 5 + 8 + 6 = 19; 19 ÷ 9 leaves remainder 1 (586 = 9 × 65 + 1).

mcqs.q: If x = 2 and y = 3, what is the value of 2x² + 3y?
Pointing to a photograph, Meera said, "He is the brother of my mother's only daughter." How is the man related to Meera?
mcqs.explanation: My mother's only daughter = Meera herself, so the man is Meera's brother.

mcqs.q: A is the father of B. B is the mother of C. D is the father of C. How is A related to D?
mcqs.explanation: D is B's husband and A is B's father, so A is D's father-in-law.

mcqs.q: If CHESS is coded as DIFTT, how is QUEEN coded in that language?
mcqs.explanation: Each letter moves +1 (C→D, H→I, E→F, S→T); so Q→R, U→V, E→F, E→F, N→O = RVFFO.

mcqs.q: In a certain code, CODE = 27, where each letter equals its alphabet-position value (C = 3, O = 15, D = 4, E = 5). What is the code for EXAM?
Find the next term: 3, 6, 12, 21, 33, ___
mcqs.explanation: Differences are 3, 6, 9, 12 — next difference 15 gives 33 + 15 = 48.

mcqs.q: Find the next term: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, ___
mcqs.explanation: These are consecutive primes; the next prime after 13 is 17.

mcqs.q: Complete the series: BC, DE, FG, HI, ___
mcqs.explanation: Each pair starts two letters after the previous one (B→D→F→H→J), so the next pair is JK.

mcqs.q: A man walks 6 km east, turns right and walks 8 km, then turns right again and walks 6 km. How far is he from his starting point?
mcqs.explanation: The 6 km east and 6 km west legs cancel, leaving 8 km (south) from the start.

mcqs.q: What is the angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock at 6:30?
mcqs.explanation: Hour hand at 195°, minute hand at 180°; the angle is |195 − 180| = 15°.

mcqs.q: If 1st January is a Friday, what day of the week is 1st February of the same year?
mcqs.explanation: January has 31 days; 31 mod 7 = 3, so Friday + 3 = Monday.

mcqs.q: Figure series: a dot occupies the top-left corner of a square, then the top-right, then the bottom-right, then the bottom-left. Where is the dot in the 5th figure?
mcqs.explanation: The dot moves clockwise around 4 corners, so after a full cycle the 5th position is again the top-left.

mcqs.q: A rectangle is divided by one vertical line and one horizontal line through its middle. Into how many parts is it divided?
mcqs.explanation: One vertical cut gives 2 strips and the horizontal cut doubles them: 2 × 2 = 4 parts.

mcqs.q: Odd one out: Equilateral triangle, Square, Regular pentagon, Right-angled scalene triangle.
mcqs.explanation: The first three are regular figures (equal sides and angles); a right-angled scalene triangle has neither.

mcqs.q: Figure analogy — Semicircle : Half of a circle :: Quadrant : ?
mcqs.explanation: A quadrant is exactly one-quarter of a circle, matching the "fraction of the whole" relation.

mcqs.q: Choose the synonym of "Candid":
mcqs.explanation: Candid means open and honest — frank. (Rude adds negativity that "candid" does not imply.)

mcqs.q: Choose the antonym of "Scarce":
mcqs.explanation: Scarce means in short supply; its opposite is abundant.

mcqs.q: One-word substitution: "A person who believes in the existence of God" is a —
mcqs.explanation: Theist = believer in God; atheist denies God, agnostic says it cannot be known.

mcqs.q: Idiom: "To let the cat out of the bag" means —
mcqs.explanation: The idiom means to disclose a secret, usually accidentally.

mcqs.q: Identify the correctly spelt word:
mcqs.explanation: Committee has double M, double T, double E — committee.

mcqs.q: Fill in the blank: "The results ___ announced tomorrow."
mcqs.explanation: Passive future needs "will be" + past participle: the results will be announced.

mcqs.q: Spot the part containing the error: (A) The Ganges is / (B) one of the longest river / (C) in India. / (D) No error
mcqs.explanation: "One of the" must be followed by a plural noun: one of the longest RIVERS.

mcqs.q: Read the passage: "Solar power is becoming cheaper every year. Panels installed on rooftops can cut electricity bills by up to 70%. However, the initial installation cost remains high for many families, so some governments offer subsidies to encourage adoption." — Why do governments offer subsidies?
options: To encourage families to adopt solar despite the high initial cost
mcqs.explanation: The passage says the initial cost is a barrier, so subsidies are offered to encourage adoption despite it.

mcqs.q: (Passage on solar power) — According to the passage, rooftop panels can cut electricity bills by —
mcqs.explanation: The passage states bills can be cut by up to 70% — the ceiling figure, not a minimum.

mcqs.q: A student's marks in five subjects are 60, 70, 80, 90 and 100. What is the average score?
mcqs.explanation: Total = 400 over 5 subjects; average = 400/5 = 80 (the data is symmetric around 80).

mcqs.q: (Marks data: 60, 70, 80, 90, 100 out of 100 each) — The total marks form what percentage of the maximum possible 500?
A shop's unit sales: Mon 40, Tue 50, Wed 30, Thu 60, Fri 70. What is the total for the five days?
(Sales data: Mon 40, Tue 50, Wed 30, Thu 60, Fri 70) — What is the ratio of Thursday's sales to Tuesday's sales?
mcqs.explanation: 60 : 50 = 6 : 5 after dividing both by 10.

chapters.title: MBA CET Mock Test 2 — Speed Practice

mcqs.q: 5 किमी उत्तर, 12 किमी पूर्व. अंतर?
What is 15% of 400?
What is the value of 0.5 × 0.02?
mcqs.explanation: 5 × 2 = 10 with four decimal places ⇒ 0.01.

mcqs.q: Quick multiplication: 45 × 11 = ?
mcqs.explanation: ×11 shortcut: split 4|5 and insert 4+5 between them ⇒ 495.

mcqs.q: If 7 pens cost ₹84, what is the cost of 5 pens?
mcqs.explanation: One pen = ₹12; 5 pens = ₹60.

mcqs.q: Express 3/5 as a percentage.
mcqs.explanation: 3/5 = 60/100 = 60% — memorise common fraction-percent pairs.

mcqs.q: Quick addition: 37 + 48 + 63 = ?
What is the average of 10, 20, 30, 40 and 50?
mcqs.explanation: For an arithmetic sequence the average is the middle term: 30.

mcqs.q: What is √2025?
A shirt marked ₹800 is sold at a 25% discount. What is the selling price?
What is the value of 2³ + 2²?
mcqs.explanation: 8 + 4 = 12. (Not 2⁵ = 32 — powers do not add.)

mcqs.q: Find the next term: 5, 10, 20, 40, ___
mcqs.explanation: Each term doubles: 40 × 2 = 80.

mcqs.q: Find the next term: 1, 4, 9, 16, ___
mcqs.explanation: Perfect squares: 5² = 25.
27, 64 and 125 are perfect cubes (3³, 4³, 5³); 100 is a perfect square, not a cube.

mcqs.q: Analogy — Pen : Write :: Knife : ?
mcqs.explanation: A pen's function is to write; a knife's primary function is to cut.

mcqs.q: Facing north, you turn 90° clockwise. Which direction are you now facing?
mcqs.explanation: From north, 90° clockwise brings you to east.

mcqs.q: If CAT is coded as DBU, how is DOG coded?
mcqs.explanation: Each letter shifts +1: D→E, O→P, G→H ⇒ EPH.

mcqs.q: Pointing to a girl, Sam said, "She is the daughter of my father's only child." How is the girl related to Sam?
mcqs.explanation: My father's only child = Sam himself, so the girl is Sam's daughter.

mcqs.q: Complete the letter series: B, D, F, H, ___
mcqs.explanation: Alternate letters (+2 each step): B, D, F, H, J.

mcqs.q: Odd one out: January, May, November, July.
mcqs.explanation: January, May and July have 31 days; November has only 30.

mcqs.q: How many times does the digit 2 appear in the number 232,452?
mcqs.explanation: The digit 2 appears at three positions: 2 3 2 4 5 2.

mcqs.q: Choose the synonym of "Brave":
mcqs.explanation: Brave = courageous; the other options differ in meaning.

mcqs.q: Choose the antonym of "Generous":
mcqs.explanation: Generous means willing to give; miserly (stingy) is its direct opposite.

mcqs.q: One-word substitution: "A person who writes books" is an —
mcqs.explanation: An author writes books; editors refine, publishers print.

mcqs.q: Idiom: "Once in a blue moon" means —
mcqs.explanation: The idiom describes something that happens very rarely.

mcqs.q: Which word is spelt correctly?
mcqs.explanation: Remember the rule "i before e except after c": receive.

mcqs.q: Fill in the blank: "She is good ___ mathematics."
mcqs.explanation: The fixed preposition after "good" for skills is "at": good at mathematics.

mcqs.q: Fill in the blank: "I have been living here ___ ten years."
mcqs.explanation: "For" is used with a duration (ten years); "since" needs a starting point.

mcqs.q: Spot the part containing the error: (A) He don't / (B) like coffee / (C) at all. / (D) No error
mcqs.explanation: With "he" the verb must be "doesn't" (does not); "don't" is the error in part (A).

mcqs.q: What is the plural of "Child"?
mcqs.explanation: "Child" forms an irregular plural: children.

mcqs.q: Fill in the blank: "The news ___ good."
mcqs.explanation: "News" is uncountable and takes a singular verb: the news is good.

mcqs.q: A shop's daily sales (units): Mon 100, Tue 120, Wed 80, Thu 140, Fri 60. What is the weekly total for these five days?
(Sales data: Mon 100, Tue 120, Wed 80, Thu 140, Fri 60) — On which day were sales the highest?
mcqs.explanation: Thursday's 140 units is the maximum of the five days.

mcqs.q: (Sales data: Mon 100, Tue 120, Wed 80, Thu 140, Fri 60) — What is the average daily sale?
mcqs.explanation: Total 500 ÷ 5 days = 100 units per day.

mcqs.q: (Sales data: Mon 100, Tue 120, Wed 80, Thu 140, Fri 60) — Wednesday's sales form what percentage of the five-day total?
In a pie chart, one category accounts for 25% of the total. What is its central angle?
mcqs.explanation: 25% of 360° = 90° (a quarter of the circle).

mcqs.q: If A > B and B > C, which statement must be true?
mcqs.explanation: Inequality is transitive: A > B > C ⇒ A > C.

mcqs.q: Simplify the ratio 25 : 35 to its lowest terms.
mcqs.explanation: Divide both terms by 5: 25 : 35 = 5 : 7.

mcqs.q: Which prime number between 30 and 40 has digits that add up to 10?
mcqs.explanation: 3 + 7 = 10 and 37 is prime (31 gives 4; 33 and 39 are not prime).

mcqs.q: A train 100 m long crosses a pole in 10 seconds. What is its speed in km/h?
A school has 500 students and 40% of them are boys. How many boys are there?
Comprehension: 'Hard work is the key to success. Those who work diligently achieve their goals.' The author's main point is:
mcqs.explanation: लेखक कठोर परिश्रमाचे महत्त्व सांगत आहे.

mcqs.q: Inference: 'Despite heavy rain, the match continued.' This implies:
options: The match was important enough to continue
mcqs.explanation: मुसळधार पाऊस असूनही सामना चालू राहिला — सामना महत्त्वाचा होता.

mcqs.q: Read the passage: 'Forests provide oxygen, prevent soil erosion, and support biodiversity. Deforestation leads to climate change.' Main idea:
mcqs.explanation: मुख्य कल्पना: जंगले पर्यावरणासाठी आवश्यक आहेत.

mcqs.q: Vocabulary: 'The teacher was meticulous in grading papers.' Here 'meticulous' means:
mcqs.explanation: Meticulous = अत्यंत काळजी घेणारा; careful, precise.

mcqs.q: Read: 'Education is a powerful weapon to change the world.' Inference:
mcqs.explanation: शिक्षण जग बदलू शकते — लेखकाचा विश्वास.

mcqs.q: Tone of passage: 'The government must take urgent action against corruption.' Tone is:
mcqs.explanation: लेखकाचा स्वर तातडीचा आहे — कारवाईची गरज दर्शवतो.

mcqs.q: Read: 'Honesty is the best policy, though difficult to follow.' Author implies:
mcqs.explanation: लेखक प्रामाणिकपणा कठीण पण फायदेशीर सांगतो.

mcqs.q: Assumption: 'Smoking causes cancer. Cancer is fatal.' Conclusion: Smoking is fatal. Valid?
mcqs.explanation: धूम्रपान → कर्करोग → घातक; निष्कर्ष वैध.

mcqs.q: Read: 'Reading improves vocabulary and critical thinking.' Inference:
mcqs.explanation: नियमित वाचन विचार क्षमता सुधारते — अनुमान.

mcqs.q: Inference: 'Although tired, she completed the marathon.' This shows:
mcqs.explanation: थकवा असूनही पूर्ण करणे — दृढनिष्ठा दर्शवते.

mcqs.q: Vocabulary: 'The politician's speech was eloquent.' Here 'eloquent' means:
mcqs.explanation: Eloquent = प्रभावशाली, सुस्पष्ट भाषण.

mcqs.q: Read: 'Time management is crucial for productivity.' Author's view:
mcqs.explanation: लेखकाचे मत: वेळ व्यवस्थापन उत्पादकता वाढवते.

mcqs.q: Read: 'Democracy requires informed citizens.' Inference:
mcqs.explanation: शिक्षण लोकशाहीसाठी आवश्यक — अनुमान.

mcqs.q: Tone: 'The unprecedented pandemic caught everyone off guard.' Tone is:
mcqs.explanation: अभूतपूर्व घटना — आश्चर्यचकित स्वर.

mcqs.q: Inference: 'Practice makes perfect. The athlete practiced daily.' Conclusion:
mcqs.explanation: दररोज सराव — परिपूर्णतेचा प्रयत्न.

mcqs.q: Which country was named the partner country of the Hornbill Festival 2025 (Nagaland)?
mcqs.explanation: The United Kingdom was the partner country of the 26th Hornbill Festival 2025 held in Nagaland.

mcqs.q: What is Sandhi?
options: दोन शब्दांमधील ध्वनींच्या मैत्रीनुसार होणारे रूपांतर
mcqs.explanation: Sandhi is the phonetic modification occurring when two words are joined, with three types - vowel, consonant and visarga sandhi.

mcqs.q: Read the passage: "The village of Haripur once depended entirely on rain-fed farming. After a small check-dam was built on its seasonal stream, groundwater levels rose and farmers shifted to vegetable cultivation, earning nearly twice as much as before." What does the passage imply?
options: Rain-fed farming is impossible in India
Small water-harvesting structures can significantly improve rural livelihoods
mcqs.explanation: The passage directly links the check-dam to rising groundwater and doubled earnings, showing how small water-harvesting works transformed rural livelihoods.

mcqs.q: Read the passage: "Studies show that people who read books regularly sleep better than those who scroll on phones before bed. The blue light from screens delays the release of melatonin, the sleep-inducing hormone." What can be inferred?
options: Screen use before bed can delay the hormone that induces sleep
Reading books cures all sleep disorders
mcqs.explanation: The passage states that screen blue light delays melatonin release; hence phone use before bed can postpone sleep. No stronger claim is made.

mcqs.q: Read the passage: "When the museum introduced free entry on Sundays, attendance tripled within a year, and most of the new visitors were first-timers from nearby towns." What is the best conclusion?
options: Museums should always charge entry fees
Removing the entry barrier attracted many first-time visitors
mcqs.explanation: Attendance tripled and new visitors were first-timers, so the direct conclusion is that free entry drew new audiences.

mcqs.q: Read the passage: 'It is ironic that the town's new water-conservation park has sprinklers running at noon, wasting hundreds of litres daily.' The tone of the author is:
mcqs.explanation: The word "ironic" and "wasting hundreds of litres" show the author is pointing out a contradiction, i.e. a critical tone.

mcqs.q: Read the passage: 'Although electric vehicles emit no exhaust, the electricity charging them often comes from coal-fired plants, and battery manufacturing is energy-intensive. Still, over their lifetime most EVs produce lower emissions than petrol cars.' What is the author's view?
options: EVs pollute more than petrol cars
Despite drawbacks, EVs generally cause lower lifetime emissions than petrol cars
mcqs.explanation: The author admits EVs are not emission-free but concludes with "Still..." that their lifetime emissions are lower — option 3 captures exactly this balanced view.

mcqs.q: Read the passage: "The librarian quietly placed a large-print edition on the desk of the elderly member who had been struggling with the regular print. He never asked for it." What does this show about the librarian?
options: The librarian was observant and considerate
mcqs.explanation: Noticing the unspoken difficulty and helping without being asked shows observation and consideration.

mcqs.q: Read the passage: "Plastic bags were banned in the city three years ago. Sellers near the markets report record cloth-bag sales, yet heaps of plastic are still found in the drains." What is the most reasonable inference?
options: The ban has solved the plastic problem completely
The ban is only partly effective, since plastic still blocks the drains
mcqs.explanation: Cloth-bag sales show partial compliance, but plastic in drains shows continued use; hence the ban is only partly effective.

mcqs.q: The manager's ultimatum left no room for negotiation. Here 'ultimatum' means:
options: A final demand that leaves no choice
mcqs.explanation: An ultimatum is a final demand whose rejection invites consequences; "no room for negotiation" confirms this sense.

mcqs.q: Read the passage: "A study of two identical schools found that the one serving free breakfast recorded higher attendance and better concentration in the first two periods." What is the main idea?
options: Free school meals can improve attendance and attention
mcqs.explanation: The study links the meal programme to better attendance and concentration, which is the central finding.

mcqs.q: Read the passage: "The young clerk noticed that the queue at the counter moved slowly, so instead of waiting for orders he opened the spare counter himself." What does the passage suggest?
options: He was waiting for orders from above
The spare counter was out of order
He showed initiative by solving the problem himself
mcqs.explanation: Acting without waiting for orders to reduce the queue shows initiative.

mcqs.q: Notice: 'Candidates without original certificates will not be admitted to the interview.' Which assumption underlies this notice?
options: Original certificates are needed for verification at the interview
mcqs.explanation: The notice makes sense only if the board intends to verify certificates in original at the interview.

mcqs.q: Read the passage: "For years the temple tank overflowed in the monsoon and dried up by February. After its bed was desilted and the channels feeding it were cleared, the water lasted till May." What is the best inference?
options: The tank was demolished last year
Rainfall that year was double the normal
Desilting helped the tank retain water longer
mcqs.explanation: The passage attributes the change to desilting and cleared channels, i.e. improved water retention.

mcqs.q: Thankfully, the fire brigade arrived within minutes — a rarity in our city, where help usually crawls in after the damage is done. The tone of the sentence is:
options: Appreciative, yet critical of the usual delay in help
mcqs.explanation: "Thankfully" praises the quick arrival while "a rarity... after the damage is done" criticises the usual delays.

mcqs.q: Read the passage: "Bilingual signs on buses helped commuters, but surveys showed that elderly passengers struggled with the small font. The transport board then ordered larger type and higher-contrast colours." What is the main idea?
options: The board improved signage after learning about readability problems
mcqs.explanation: Survey feedback about font size led the board to order larger, higher-contrast lettering — the core idea.

mcqs.q: Read the passage: "Many farmers switched from cotton to millets when a state scheme guaranteed purchase prices. Millets need far less water, so the tail-end villages of the canal finally received water in the dry season." What does the passage imply?
options: Cotton needs less water than millets
The shift to less water-thirsty crops eased seasonal water scarcity
mcqs.explanation: Because millets are less water-thirsty, downstream villages got canal water in the dry season — reduced water stress.

mcqs.q: वाचा: "सहावीपासूनच्या मुलींना शाळेतून सायकल मिळाल्यानंतर गावातील शाळेत हजरी ७५% वरून ९२% झाली. पालकांनी सांगितले की दूरच्या शाळेपर्यंत जाण्याचा प्रश्न आता राहिला नाही." या उताऱ्यातून काय अनुमान निघते?
options: वाहतुकीची सोय सुलभ झाल्याने मुलींची हजरी सुधारली
mcqs.explanation: Cycles removed the travel difficulty, and attendance rose from 75% to 92% — easier transport improved attendance.

mcqs.q: वाचा: "जिल्हा परिषद शाळेने आपल्या आवारात शंभर वृक्ष लावले. दोन वर्षांत उन्हाळ्यातही आवारातील तापमान कमी झाल्याचे विद्यार्थ्यांनी नोंदवले." याची मुख्य कल्पना कोणती?
mcqs.explanation: The passage links tree plantation with lower summer temperature — the main idea is the cooling effect of trees.

mcqs.q: वाचा: "रुग्णालयात मोफत हेल्पलाइन सुरू झाल्यानंतर ग्रामीण रुग्णांना योग्य वेळेत योग्य विभागात उपचार मिळाल्याचे अहवालात नोंदविण्यात आले." सर्वात योग्य अनुमान कोणता?
options: हेल्पलाइनने ग्रामीण रुग्णांना मार्गदर्शन सुलभ केले
mcqs.explanation: The helpline helped rural patients reach the right department at the right time — guidance became easier.

mcqs.q: वाचा: आश्चर्य म्हणजे, गटार तोंडी 'स्वच्छता अभियान' चा फलक आहे आणि तेथेच कचरा साचला आहे! लेखकाचा स्वर कोणता?
mcqs.explanation: The contrast between the cleanliness-campaign board and the heap of garbage, with "आश्चर्य म्हणजे", gives a sarcastic tone.

mcqs.q: वाचा: "ग्रामीण बँकेने घरपोच सेवा सुरू केल्यावर वृद्ध शेतकऱ्यांना बँकेसाठी दोन किलोमीटर चालण्याची गरज राहिली नाही." या सेवेचा सर्वाधिक फायदा कोणाला होतो?
mcqs.explanation: The passage specifically mentions elderly farmers being spared a two-kilometre walk — the elderly and distant customers benefit most.

mcqs.q: वाचा: "महामार्गावरील एका ठिकाणी अपघात वारंवार होत होते. तेथे सुधारित रस्ता-चिन्हे व परावर्तक रोषणाई बसवल्यानंतर अपघात अर्ध्याहून कमी झाले." योग्य निष्कर्ष कोणता?
options: धोकादायक ठिकाणी सुधारणा केल्याने अपघात कमी झाले
mcqs.explanation: Accidents halved after better signage and reflective lighting at the black spot — targeted road-safety improvements work.

mcqs.q: वाचा: "शेतकऱ्यांनी स्वतःचा फळभाजी बाजार सुरू केला. मध्यस्थांची गरज कमी झाली आणि उत्पादकांचा नफा दुपटीत झाला." यातून काय अनुमान निघते?
options: मध्यस्थी कमी झाल्याने उत्पादकांचा नफा वाढला
mcqs.explanation: Direct selling reduced middlemen and doubled producer profit — less middleman margin, more farmer income.

mcqs.q: वाचा: 'त्याचे वक्तव्य अतिशय संयमित होते; त्यात कोणताही राग नव्हता.' येथे 'संयमित' म्हणजे काय?
mcqs.explanation: संयमित = calm and composed; the sentence itself says "no anger" which confirms the meaning.

mcqs.q: वाचा: "गावातील सर्वेक्षणात ८०% मुले मोफत शिकवणीवर हजर होती. तथापि, ग्रंथालय बंद असल्याने अभ्यासासाठी पुस्तकांची कमतरता भासत होती." उताऱ्यातील समस्या कोणती?
mcqs.explanation: "तथापि" (however) marks the problem: with the library shut, books were short for study.

mcqs.q: वाचा: "पावसाचे पाणी साठवणाऱ्या शेततळ्यांच्या योजनेत लाभ घेतलेल्या शेतकऱ्यांनी उन्हाळ्यातही दुसरे पीक घेतले; न घेतलेल्यांची जमीन पडत राहिली." योग्य निष्कर्ष कोणता?
options: पाण्याची उपलब्धता हंगामी पिकांसाठी निर्णायक ठरली
mcqs.explanation: Only farmers with stored water could take a summer crop — water availability decided seasonal cropping.

mcqs.q: एक अधिकारी आपल्या अधीनस्थांवर ओरडतो. सर्वात योग्य प्रतिसाद काय?
mcqs.explanation: शांतपणे प्रतिसाद द्या — संवाद कौशल्य.

mcqs.q: टीम मध्ये मतभेद असल्यास काय करावे?
mcqs.explanation: चर्चा करून समाधान काढा — टीमवर्क.

mcqs.q: सहकाऱ्याला समस्या आहे हे जाणवल्यास काय करावे?
mcqs.explanation: सहानुभूती दाखवा — समजून घ्या.

mcqs.q: प्रभावी संवादासाठी सर्वात महत्त्वाचे काय?
mcqs.explanation: सक्रिय श्रवण — प्रभावी संवादाचा पाया.

mcqs.q: संघर्ष निवारणाचा सर्वोत्तम मार्ग कोणता?
mcqs.explanation: विजय-विजय दृष्टिकोन — सर्वांना फायदा.

mcqs.q: नेतृत्व कौशल्यात सर्वात महत्त्वाचे काय?
mcqs.explanation: विश्वास व सहानुभूती नेतृत्वाचा आधार.

mcqs.q: संवादात नेत्र संपर्क कशाचे द्योतक आहे?
mcqs.explanation: नेत्र संपर्क — आत्मविश्वास व लक्ष दर्शवतो.

mcqs.q: सक्रिय श्रवण म्हणजे काय?
mcqs.explanation: सक्रिय श्रवण — लक्ष, समज व प्रतिसाद द्यावे.

mcqs.q: भावनिक बुद्धिमत्ता (EQ) म्हणजे काय?
mcqs.explanation: EQ — भावना समजून घेणे व व्यवस्थापित करणे.

mcqs.q: टीम कामात सर्वात महत्त्वाचे काय?
mcqs.explanation: सहयोग — टीम कामाचा आधार.

mcqs.q: संवादात 'मी' ऐवजी 'आपण' कसे वापरावे?
mcqs.explanation: 'आपण' वापरल्याने टीम भावना दिसते.

mcqs.q: ग्राहक रागावला असल्यास काय करावे?
mcqs.explanation: ग्राहकाची तक्रार शांतपणे ऐका व समस्या सोडवा.

mcqs.q: नेतृत्व शैलीत सर्वात प्रभावी कोणती?
mcqs.explanation: लोकशाही नेतृत्व — सर्वांचा सहभाग व विश्वास.

mcqs.q: प्रभावी प्रस्तुतीसाठी सर्वात महत्त्वाचे काय?
mcqs.explanation: स्पष्ट संदेश — प्रभावी प्रस्तुतीचा आधार.

mcqs.q: सहानुभूती व सहानुभूती मध्ये काय फरक आहे?
options: सहानुभूती: भावना समजणे; सहानुभूती: दुःख वाटणे
mcqs.explanation: सहानुभूती (Empathy) — इतरांच्या भावना समजणे; सहानुभूती (Sympathy) — दुःख वाटणे.

mcqs.q: Your subordinate repeatedly misses deadlines but is otherwise talented. As his officer, what is the best first step?
options: Report the matter to HR immediately
Have a private conversation to understand the reasons and set clear expectations
Criticize him publicly in the next meeting
Reassign all his work without any explanation
mcqs.explanation: Constructive handling starts with a private, fact-finding conversation; public criticism or escalation only damages trust.

mcqs.q: In a meeting, a colleague keeps interrupting you. What is the best response?
options: Stay silent for the rest of the meeting
Calmly assert your point, finish it, and later discuss the pattern privately
mcqs.explanation: Calm assertion protects your position in the meeting, and a private talk addresses the behaviour without public confrontation.

mcqs.q: Which of the following is the most effective piece of feedback?
options: "Your report was well researched; adding data analysis would make it stronger."
mcqs.explanation: Effective feedback is specific and balanced — it names the strength and a concrete improvement, unlike the other vague or abusive options.

mcqs.q: Which of the following is an element of non-verbal communication?
options: Words used in an official memo
Body posture, gestures, facial expression and eye contact
Number of pages in a report
mcqs.explanation: Posture, gestures, expressions and eye contact carry meaning without words — the essence of non-verbal communication.

mcqs.q: A citizen at your counter is angry and uses harsh words. What should you do?
options: Match his tone to show authority
Listen patiently, acknowledge the grievance and explain the remedy calmly
Leave the counter and go inside
mcqs.explanation: Patient listening plus a calm explanation of the remedy de-escalates anger and serves the citizen; escalation helps no one.

mcqs.q: Active listening primarily requires:
options: Listening fully without interruption, clarifying through questions and summarizing what was understood
Interrupting quickly with your own views
Planning your reply while the other person speaks
mcqs.explanation: Active listening = full attention + clarification + feedback/summary; planning your reply means you are not truly listening.

mcqs.q: Two departments blame each other for a delayed project. As coordinator, what is the best approach?
options: Facilitate a joint factual review to locate the bottleneck and agree on corrective steps
mcqs.explanation: A joint fact-based review is win-win: it fixes the process instead of fixing blame.

mcqs.q: You receive a written order that seems ambiguous and possibly erroneous. What should you do?
options: Seek written clarification from the issuing authority before acting
mcqs.explanation: Clarification from the issuing authority protects both the work and the officer; guessing or ignoring is risky.

mcqs.q: Emotional intelligence in the workplace mainly means:
options: Recognizing and managing one's own emotions and understanding those of others
mcqs.explanation: EQ = self-awareness and self-management plus empathy for others, as the chapter notes say: self-awareness + social awareness.

mcqs.q: A new junior hesitates to speak in meetings. As team leader, what is the best action?
options: Mock him so that he becomes bold
Encourage him, invite his views and give credit when he performs
Do his share of the work yourself
mcqs.explanation: Encouragement and recognition build confidence and participation; mockery or neglect destroys it.

mcqs.q: Which channel is most appropriate for discussing a sensitive performance issue with a subordinate?
options: A notice on the public board
A sarcastic email copied to all
mcqs.explanation: Sensitive matters demand privacy and two-way dialogue; public channels humiliate and breed resentment.

mcqs.q: A colleague presents your work as his own before the boss. What is the best response?
options: Quarrel with him in the office
Politely show the boss your documented contribution and clarify the facts
mcqs.explanation: Facts and documentation, presented politely, correct the record without worsening workplace relations.

mcqs.q: What is true about "grapevine" (informal) communication in offices?
options: It is the most official channel
It is informal; useful for bonding but prone to rumours, so verify before acting
mcqs.explanation: The grapevine spreads fast and builds bonds, but it is rumour-prone — always verify before acting on it.

mcqs.q: A tender decision you are handling will slightly benefit a firm owned by your relative. What is the right course?
options: Expand the order for the firm
Disclose the conflict of interest and withdraw from that decision
mcqs.explanation: Disclosure and recusal are the standard integrity steps; concealment or denial is misconduct.

mcqs.q: A citizen makes a request that is not permissible under the rules. How should you decline it?
options: Explain the rule and its reason, and suggest any lawful alternative
mcqs.explanation: A respectful refusal explains the rule and offers lawful alternatives — it preserves public trust.

mcqs.q: Empathy in the workplace means:
options: Understanding and acknowledging others' feelings while making a fair decision
mcqs.explanation: Empathy is understanding others' feelings and perspectives; it does not require surrendering fairness.

mcqs.q: Your team is demoralized after a project failed. As the leader, what is the best action?
options: Hold a review to draw lessons, appreciate the effort and chart corrective steps
mcqs.explanation: A blame-free review extracts lessons, restores morale and produces corrective action — the true leadership response to failure.

mcqs.q: Written communication is preferred over oral communication when:
options: For spreading news fastest among friends
When a record, accuracy and future reference are required
mcqs.explanation: Written form provides a permanent, precise record for future reference — its core advantage over speech.

mcqs.q: Two subordinates have a personal conflict that is affecting work. What is the best handling?
options: Transfer both as a routine measure
Listen to both separately and then facilitate a resolution centred on professional conduct
mcqs.explanation: Listening to both sides and facilitating a work-focused resolution addresses the cause; ignoring or routine transfers do not.

mcqs.q: While communicating with people of different languages and cultures, the best practice is to:
options: Respect linguistic differences, use simple clear language and confirm understanding
mcqs.explanation: Simple, clear language with confirmation of understanding bridges linguistic differences; jargon and insistence widen them.

mcqs.q: You receive repeated anonymous complaints about a colleague's behaviour. What should you do?
options: Publish the complaints to warn him
Verify the facts discreetly through the proper channel and act as per rules
Announce the name of the complainant
mcqs.explanation: Anonymous inputs warrant discreet verification through proper channels, followed by rule-based action if substantiated.

mcqs.q: The "7 Cs" of effective communication include:
mcqs.explanation: The 7 Cs are Clarity, Conciseness, Concreteness, Correctness, Coherence, Completeness and Courtesy.

mcqs.q: During a video-conference meeting, the best practice is to:
options: Keep the mic muted unless speaking, look at the camera, and end by summarizing action points
mcqs.explanation: Mic discipline, camera eye-contact and a closing summary of action points make online meetings effective.

mcqs.q: A trainee repeatedly asks basic questions and senior staff are getting annoyed. The best mentor attitude is to:
options: Ridicule him to make him independent
Ask him to stop asking questions
Answer patiently and prepare a short guide/handbook for common queries
mcqs.explanation: Patient answers plus a ready handbook solve the trainee's doubts once and for all, and free the seniors from repetition.

mcqs.q: Assertive communication means:
options: Expressing one's views and needs firmly yet respectfully, while respecting others' rights
mcqs.explanation: Assertiveness stands between aggression (dominating) and submission (surrendering): firm, respectful expression of one's own rights while honouring others'.

mcqs.q: रक्तसंबंध: A हा B चा भाऊ, B ही C ची आई. A हा C चा कोण?
mcqs.explanation: A हा B (C ची आई) चा भाऊ → A हा C चा मामा.

mcqs.q: दिशा: 5 किमी उत्तर, उजवीकडे 3 किमी. सुरुवातीपासून अंतर?
सादृश्यता: पेन : लिहिणे :: चाकू : ?
mcqs.explanation: पेन लिहिण्यासाठी; चाकू कापण्यासाठी.

mcqs.q: रक्तसंबंध: एक व्यक्ती म्हणतो, 'ती माझ्या आईच्या एकमेव मुलीची मुलगी आहे.' ती कोण?
mcqs.explanation: आईची एकमेव मुलगी = स्वतः; तिची मुलगी = मुलगी.

mcqs.q: What is the next number in the series: 5, 11, 23, 47, ?
mcqs.explanation: Each term is (previous × 2 + 1): 47 × 2 + 1 = 95.

mcqs.q: Find the next term: 3, 7, 15, 31, 63, ?
mcqs.explanation: Pattern is ×2 + 1, or terms equal 2^n − 1; next = 2^7 − 1 = 127.

mcqs.q: Find the next term: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
mcqs.explanation: Differences are 4, 6, 8, 10, so next difference is 12: 30 + 12 = 42 (terms are n(n+1)).

mcqs.q: Find the next term: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, ?
mcqs.explanation: These are perfect squares 1², 2², 3²...; next is 6² = 36.

mcqs.q: Find the next term: 8, 27, 64, 125, ?
mcqs.explanation: These are cubes: 2³, 3³, 4³, 5³; next is 6³ = 216.

mcqs.q: Find the next term: 4, 9, 19, 39, 79, ?
mcqs.explanation: Each term is (previous × 2 + 1): 79 × 2 + 1 = 159.

mcqs.q: Find the next term: 7, 14, 28, 56, ?
mcqs.explanation: Each term doubles the previous one: 56 × 2 = 112.

mcqs.q: Find the next letter in the series: A, C, F, J, O, ?
mcqs.explanation: Gaps are +2, +3, +4, +5 letters; next gap is +6: O (15) + 6 = 21 = U.

mcqs.q: In a certain code, TEACHER is written as VGCEJGT. How is CHILD written in that code?
mcqs.explanation: Each letter is shifted +2: C→E, H→J, I→K, L→N, D→F gives EJKMF.

mcqs.q: If MUMBAI is coded as NVNCBJ (each letter shifted by one), how is PUNE coded?
mcqs.explanation: Shifting each letter +1: P→Q, U→V, N→O, E→F = QVOF.

mcqs.q: In a certain code, DELHI is written as CDKGH. How is MUMBAI written in that code?
mcqs.explanation: Each letter is shifted −1: M→L, U→T, M→L, B→A, A→Z, I→H = LTLAZH.

mcqs.q: If WATER is coded as YCVGT (each letter +2), then EARTH is coded as:
mcqs.explanation: Shifting each letter +2: E→G, A→C, R→T, T→V, H→J = GCTVJ.

mcqs.q: In a certain code, 5 × 4 = 15 and 7 × 6 = 35. Following the same rule, 9 × 8 = ?
If RAT is coded as SBU and DOG as EPH, how is COW coded?
mcqs.explanation: Each letter moves +1: C→D, O→P, W→X = DPX.

mcqs.q: In a code language, 'sea is deep' means 'ti pa na' and 'sky is blue' means 'ka pa ja'. What is the code for 'is'?
mcqs.explanation: 'is' is common to both sentences and 'pa' is the only common code word, so is = pa.

mcqs.q: Pointing to a man, Sita said, 'He is the son of my grandfather's only son.' How is the man related to Sita?
mcqs.explanation: Grandfather's only son = Sita's father; his son = Sita's brother.

mcqs.q: A is the sister of B. C is the mother of B. D is the father of C. How is A related to D?
mcqs.explanation: C is A's mother and D is C's father, so D is A's grandfather and A is his granddaughter.

mcqs.q: Pointing to a photograph, Raj said, 'She is the daughter of my grandfather's only child.' How is she related to Raj?
mcqs.explanation: Grandfather's only child = Raj's parent; that parent's daughter = Raj's sister.

mcqs.q: P is the husband of Q. R is the mother of S and Q. What is R to P?
mcqs.explanation: R is the mother of Q, and P is Q's husband; hence R is P's mother-in-law.

mcqs.q: Introducing a boy, a girl said, 'His mother is the only daughter of my mother.' How is the boy related to the girl?
mcqs.explanation: The only daughter of the girl's mother is the girl herself, so the boy is her son.

mcqs.q: X and Y are brothers. Z is the son of Y. W is the wife of X. How is Z related to X?
mcqs.explanation: Z is the son of X's brother Y, so Z is X's nephew.

mcqs.q: Ravi walks 5 km towards North, turns right and walks 3 km, then turns right again and walks 5 km. How far and in which direction is he from the starting point?
mcqs.explanation: The 5 km North and 5 km South cancel out; net displacement is 3 km towards East.

mcqs.q: A man walks 4 km South, turns left and walks 3 km, turns left again and walks 4 km. How far is he from the start?
mcqs.explanation: The two 4 km legs (South and North) cancel; net displacement is 3 km.

mcqs.q: Amit, facing North, turns 90° clockwise and then 180° anticlockwise. Which direction is he facing now?
mcqs.explanation: North +90° clockwise = East; East −180° = West.

mcqs.q: A person walks facing the rising sun, then turns to his left. Which direction is he facing now?
mcqs.explanation: The sun rises in the East; a left turn from East faces North.

mcqs.q: Sita walks 2 km North, turns right and walks 4 km, turns right and walks 3 km, turns left and walks 1 km, then turns left and walks 1 km. How far is she from the starting point?
mcqs.explanation: Net: East 4+1 = 5 km; North 2−3+1 = 0. She is exactly 5 km East of the start.

mcqs.q: If South-East becomes North and North-East becomes West, then what does West become?
mcqs.explanation: Every direction rotates 135° anticlockwise (SE→N, NE→W both confirm it); West (270°) − 135° = 135° = South-East.

mcqs.q: Which number does not belong to the group: 3, 5, 9, 11?
mcqs.explanation: 3, 5 and 11 are prime numbers; 9 = 3 × 3 is not prime.

mcqs.q: Find the odd one out: 121, 144, 169, 190.
mcqs.explanation: 121 = 11², 144 = 12², 169 = 13² are perfect squares; 190 is not.

mcqs.q: Find the odd one out: Mango, Apple, Potato, Banana.
mcqs.explanation: Mango, apple and banana are fruits; potato is a vegetable (underground stem/tuber).

mcqs.q: Find the odd one out: 8, 27, 64, 100.
mcqs.explanation: 8 = 2³, 27 = 3³, 64 = 4³ are perfect cubes; 100 = 10² is a square, not a cube.

mcqs.q: Find the odd one out: 14, 45, 21, 35.
mcqs.explanation: 14, 21 and 35 are multiples of 7; 45 is not.

mcqs.q: Statements: All teachers are graduates. Some graduates are officers. Conclusions: I. Some teachers are officers. II. All officers are graduates. Which conclusion(s) follow?
mcqs.explanation: The graduates who are officers need not be teachers, so I fails; II wrongly converts "some" into "all". Neither follows.

mcqs.q: Statements: All roses are flowers. All flowers are plants. Conclusion: All roses are plants. Does the conclusion follow?
mcqs.explanation: Roses ⊂ Flowers ⊂ Plants, so by transitivity all roses are plants — valid.

mcqs.q: Statements: All crows are black. Some black things are beautiful. Conclusion: Some crows are beautiful. Does the conclusion follow?
options: Either conclusion or its negation follows
mcqs.explanation: The beautiful black things may all be non-crows, so the conclusion is not guaranteed — it does not follow.

mcqs.q: Statements: No pen is a pencil. All pencils are erasers. Conclusions: I. No pen is an eraser. II. Some erasers are pencils. Which follows?
mcqs.explanation: "All pencils are erasers" gives "some erasers are pencils" (II is valid); I wrongly extends the exclusion to all erasers.

mcqs.q: Statements: Some doctors are teachers. All teachers are writers. Conclusion: Some writers are doctors. Does it follow?
mcqs.explanation: The doctors who are teachers are also writers, so some writers are definitely doctors — valid.

mcqs.q: Book : Pages :: Ladder : ?
mcqs.explanation: A book is made up of pages; a ladder is made up of rungs (whole : parts).

mcqs.q: Doctor : Hospital :: Teacher : ?
mcqs.explanation: A doctor works in a hospital; a teacher works in a school (worker : workplace).
512 = 8³, so the relation is cube: 6³ = 216.

mcqs.q: तुम्ही एक अधिकारी आहात. तुमचा मित्र अवैध कामाची विनंती करतो. काय कराल?
mcqs.explanation: अवैध कामास नकार — नैतिक निर्णय.

mcqs.q: एका गावात पाणीटंभाची कमतरता आहे. प्राधान्य काय?
mcqs.explanation: सर्वांना समान पाणी — न्याय्य वाटप.

mcqs.q: अधीनस्थ नियम तोडतो. काय कराल?
mcqs.explanation: नियमानुसार कारवाई — कायदेशीर दृष्टिकोन.

mcqs.q: रस्त्यावर अपघात झाला. प्रथम काय?
mcqs.explanation: प्रथम वैद्यकीय मदत — जीव वाचवणे प्राधान्य.

mcqs.q: घरातील चोरी झाली. पोलिस तपास करत आहेत. काय कराल?
mcqs.explanation: तपासात सहयोग — कायदेशीर जबाबदारी.

mcqs.q: प्रकल्पाची शेवटची तारीख जवळ आहे. काय कराल?
mcqs.explanation: प्राधान्यक्रम लावून काम पूर्ण करा.

mcqs.q: अधिकारी घूस घेतो. तुम्हाला काय करावे?
mcqs.explanation: भ्रष्टाचाराची तक्रार — लोकहित.

mcqs.q: गावात पूर आला. प्राधान्य काय?
mcqs.explanation: प्राण वचवणे व स्थलांतर — प्राधान्य.

mcqs.q: टीम मध्ये सदस्य काम करत नाही. काय कराल?
mcqs.explanation: संवाद साधून समस्या समजा व सोडवा.

mcqs.q: एक निर्णय घेताना सर्वात महत्त्वाचे काय?
mcqs.explanation: नैतिकता व जनहित — प्रशासकाचे प्राधान्य.

mcqs.q: नागरिकांच्या तक्रारींवर किती वेळात प्रतिसाद?
mcqs.explanation: 48 तासांत प्रतिसाद — प्रशासकीय कार्यक्षमता.

mcqs.q: एखाद्या समस्येचे विश्लेषण करताना पहिली पायरी?
mcqs.explanation: मूळ कारण शोधा — समस्या निवारणाचा आधार.

mcqs.q: नैतिक दुर्बोधात कोणता निर्णय योग्य?
mcqs.explanation: नियम व जनहितानुसार निर्णय — नैतिक दुर्बोधात योग्य.

mcqs.q: घोटाळा आढळल्यास काय कराल?
mcqs.explanation: तपास व अहवाल — जनहित व कायदा.

mcqs.q: निर्णयाची प्रभावीपणा कशी मोजावी?
mcqs.explanation: परिणाम व जनहित — निर्णय प्रभावीपणाचा मोजमाप.

mcqs.q: A contractor whose tender you recently approved sends you an expensive gift as a "token of thanks". What is the best course of action?
options: Politely refuse and report the matter as per the conduct rules
Accept it quietly since the tender process is complete
Accept now and return it after a few months
Ask him to give cash instead
mcqs.explanation: Gifts linked to official decisions compromise integrity; refusal plus reporting per conduct rules is the only clean option.

mcqs.q: You discover a technical error in a report you yourself submitted last week. What should you do?
options: Wait and see if anyone notices
Inform your superiors immediately and submit a corrected version
Quietly change the office copy only
Blame the junior clerk who typed it
mcqs.explanation: Transparency and prompt correction protect public interest; concealment or blame-shifting deepens the mistake.

mcqs.q: During floods, your rescue team has one boat and two simultaneous requests: evacuate 100 children trapped in a school, or shift office equipment from a flooded godown. What should you do?
options: Save the equipment first as it is costly
Split time equally between the two tasks
Wait for additional boats and do nothing
mcqs.explanation: Life is always the first priority in disaster response; property can be replaced, lives cannot.

mcqs.q: An informer tells you anonymously about illegal sand mining at night in your taluka. What is the best action?
options: Ignore it since it is anonymous
Verify discreetly and initiate lawful action, keeping the informer's identity confidential
Ask the local MLA to decide
mcqs.explanation: Verification followed by lawful action protects both public interest and the informer; disclosure could endanger him.

mcqs.q: Your superior gives you an oral order that appears to violate a statutory rule. What should you do?
options: Respectfully point out the relevant rule and seek written orders before acting
Carry it out quickly to please the boss
Refuse rudely in front of the staff
Leak the order to the media
mcqs.explanation: Recording the objection and seeking written orders is the standard protection for both the officer and the rules.

mcqs.q: At year-end, some budget remains unspent and colleagues press you to "use it up anyhow". What is the right decision?
options: Spend the balance on anything to avoid lapse
Return it and blame the finance department
Spend strictly as per the sanctioned plan and genuine needs
mcqs.explanation: Public money must be spent only for sanctioned, genuine purposes; wasteful rush expenditure is misuse of funds.

mcqs.q: A journalist asks you for details of an inquiry that is still in progress. What do you tell him?
options: Share only officially releasable information without speculation
Refuse to speak and walk away
Give unofficial hints to the press
mcqs.explanation: An officer must be transparent within limits: share only what is officially releasable and avoid speculation on a live inquiry.

mcqs.q: You receive complaints that a shopkeeper near a school sells tobacco products to minors. As the officer, what is the best course?
options: Ignore it; sales are his livelihood
Order immediate demolition of his shop
Verify the complaint and initiate action as per law after giving him a hearing
mcqs.explanation: Due process applies even to wrongdoers: verify, issue notice/hearing, then take lawful action.

mcqs.q: The lowest bidder in a tender has submitted work of clearly substandard quality earlier. What should you do?
options: Award to the lowest bidder regardless of quality
Award to a bidder you personally know
Reject as per documented quality assessment under the tender conditions
mcqs.explanation: Tender conditions usually permit rejection on documented quality grounds — objective, recorded criteria prevent favouritism.

mcqs.q: You see your close friend, also an officer, accepting money from a party. What is the best response?
options: Ignore it, he is your friend
Advise him to return the amount and report the matter through the proper channel
Ask for a share of the money
mcqs.explanation: Loyalty cannot override law; advising correction and reporting through the channel is both ethical and protective.

mcqs.q: A project requires displacing 50 families. What is the fairest way to proceed?
options: Consult the affected families and ensure compensation and rehabilitation before proceeding
Let the police handle the resistance
mcqs.explanation: Development must be humane: consultation plus assured rehabilitation before displacement is the just administrative standard.

mcqs.q: Your data-entry staff keeps making errors, generating public grievances. What is the best systemic response?
options: Analyse the root cause, retrain staff and introduce a verification step
Do the corrections yourself every time
mcqs.explanation: Root-cause analysis (training + a check step) fixes the system; punishing everyone or manual patching does not.

mcqs.q: Parents complain about the quality of mid-day meals in schools. What is the best first action?
options: Wait for written complaints to accumulate
Close the scheme for a month
Conduct a surprise inspection, test samples and act as per rules
mcqs.explanation: Surprise inspection with sample testing gives objective evidence before any action — protecting children is urgent.

mcqs.q: A well-wisher offers to get you a coveted posting through "influence". What should you do?
options: Decline the improper route and pursue the post through the proper channel
Ask for a better post through the same route
mcqs.explanation: Postings obtained through influence are improper and risky; the proper channel preserves both career and conscience.

mcqs.q: You are posted on election duty at a booth where a close relative is a candidate. What should you do?
options: Manage the booth informally in his favour
Do nothing and hope no one notices
Disclose the conflict and request reassignment from that duty
mcqs.explanation: Conflict of interest in elections must be disclosed and the officer reassigned to protect impartiality.

mcqs.q: A rumour spreads that the town water supply is contaminated and people panic. What is the best response?
options: Announce that everything is fine without checks
Get samples tested immediately and issue a factual public clarification
Arrest those spreading the rumour first
Wait for the panic to die down
mcqs.explanation: Quick laboratory testing followed by a factual announcement replaces panic with reliable information.

mcqs.q: A local MLA pressures you to add ineligible names to a beneficiary list. What should you do?
options: Add the names to maintain relations
Add a few names as a compromise
Leave the decision to the clerk
Politely refuse, cite the eligibility rules and record the exchange in writing
mcqs.explanation: Eligibility rules are binding on everyone; a written, polite refusal creates accountability and protects the officer.

mcqs.q: Your subordinate admits he made an honest mistake that caused a small loss. What is the best course?
options: Forgive him and hide the loss
Take corrective steps and follow due departmental process, treating his honesty as a mitigating factor
Make him repay from his salary immediately
mcqs.explanation: Correction plus due process balances accountability with fairness; honesty is a relevant mitigating factor.

mcqs.q: Disaster relief funds are insufficient to cover every affected person fully. How should you allocate them?
options: Distribute equally to everyone including the unaffected
Give all money to the loudest group
Prioritize by transparent vulnerability criteria and document the allocation
mcqs.explanation: Transparent, criteria-based prioritization ensures the most vulnerable get help first and decisions remain defensible.

mcqs.q: You learn that a question paper of a recruitment exam has leaked. What should you do?
options: Warn only the students concerned quietly
Report it immediately to the competent authority for an inquiry
mcqs.explanation: A paper leak strikes at fairness itself; immediate reporting for inquiry is the only lawful response.

mcqs.q: A road-widening plan requires touching an old temple structure. What is the best approach?
options: Demolish it overnight with police help
Follow heritage/legal procedure, take expert opinion and consult the community before deciding
mcqs.explanation: Heritage structures need legal procedure, expert assessment and community consultation — balancing faith, law and development.

mcqs.q: A farmer's crop-insurance claim was rejected because of a wrong data entry by the office. What should you do?
options: Let the rejection stand as the system output
Ask the farmer to file a court case
Delay it until the next financial year
Re-verify the records and correct the decision promptly
mcqs.explanation: When the error is the office's own, prompt re-verification and correction is both just and administratively required.

mcqs.q: You come to know that a colleague leaks internal discussion details to the media. What should you do?
options: Confront him with accusations in public
Leak something about him in return
Report the verified facts to your superior as per protocol
mcqs.explanation: Verified facts reported through protocol handle the breach professionally; retaliation or gossip worsens it.

mcqs.q: Limited funds allow either new office furniture or repair of school classrooms in urgent disrepair. Where should the money go?
options: Repair of school classrooms in urgent disrepair
A farewell party for a retired officer
mcqs.explanation: Public money must follow greatest public need — children's safety in classrooms outweighs office comfort.

mcqs.q: A proposal beneficial to your own native village comes before you for sanction. What is the best course?
options: Approve it quickly since you know the need
Recuse yourself and have it examined impartially by others
Reject it outright to look impartial
mcqs.explanation: Recusal lets the proposal be judged on merit by unbiased persons, protecting both fairness and your integrity.

mcqs.q: घड्याळात 3:00 वाजता काट्यांमधील कोन किती?
mcqs.explanation: तास काटा 3 वर, मिनिट काटा 12 वर → 90°.

mcqs.q: 1 जानेवारी 2024 रोजी कोणता दिवस होता?
घड्याळात 6:00 वाजता काट्यांमधील कोन किती?
mcqs.explanation: तास काटा 6 वर, मिनिट काटा 12 वर → 180°.

mcqs.q: एका घनाचे 3 समान भागात कापले. एकूण किती छोटे घन?
1 जानेवारी 2023 रोजी कोणता दिवस होता?
घड्याळात 12:00 वाजता काट्यांमधील कोन?
What is 15% of 480?
A number increased by 25% becomes 500. What is the number?
If the price of sugar rises by 20%, by what per cent must a family reduce its consumption so that the expenditure remains unchanged?
mcqs.explanation: Required reduction = 20/120 = 1/6 = 16 2/3 % (shortcut: r/(100+r) × 100).

mcqs.q: A student scores 180 marks out of 250. What is his percentage?
A town's population of 20,000 increases by 10% in the first year and decreases by 5% in the second year. What is the population at the end of two years?
Divide ₹1,200 among A, B and C in the ratio 2 : 3 : 5. What is C's share?
mcqs.explanation: Total parts = 10, one part = ₹120; C gets 5 × 120 = ₹600.

mcqs.q: The ratio of the present ages of A and B is 3 : 5. After 6 years, the ratio becomes 3 : 4. What is the sum of their present ages?
mcqs.explanation: (3k+6)/(5k+6) = 3/4 gives k = 2; present ages 6 and 10, sum = 16 years.

mcqs.q: Two numbers are in the ratio 5 : 7 and their sum is 96. What is their difference?
mcqs.explanation: One part = 96/12 = 8; numbers are 40 and 56, difference = 16 (or (7−5) × 8).

mcqs.q: A 40-litre mixture contains milk and water in the ratio 7 : 1. How much water must be added to make the ratio 7 : 3?
mcqs.explanation: Milk = 35 L, water = 5 L; for 7 : 3, water must be 15 L, so add 10 litres.

mcqs.q: If a : b = 2 : 3 and b : c = 4 : 5, then a : c = ?
mcqs.explanation: Make b equal: a : b = 8 : 12 and b : c = 12 : 15, so a : c = 8 : 15.

mcqs.q: The average of 5 numbers is 27. If one number, 35, is excluded, what is the average of the remaining numbers?
mcqs.explanation: Total = 135; removing 35 leaves 100 over 4 numbers = 25.

mcqs.q: What is the average of the first 20 natural numbers?
The average of 11 results is 50. The average of the first six is 49 and that of the last six is 52. What is the sixth result?
mcqs.explanation: 6 × 49 + 6 × 52 − 11 × 50 = 294 + 312 − 550 = 56 (the sixth result is counted twice).

mcqs.q: A batsman's average in 8 innings is 44. How many runs must he score in the 9th innings to raise his average to 48?
mcqs.explanation: Required total = 9 × 48 = 432; already 8 × 44 = 352; so he needs 432 − 352 = 80.

mcqs.q: Find the simple interest on ₹5,000 at 8% per annum for 3 years.
At what rate of simple interest per annum will a sum double itself in 8 years?
mcqs.explanation: To double, SI must equal P in 8 years: R = 100/8 = 12.5% per annum.

mcqs.q: In how many years will ₹800 amount to ₹920 at 5% per annum simple interest?
A sum at simple interest amounts to ₹720 in 2 years and ₹1,020 in 5 years. What is the principal?
mcqs.explanation: Interest for 3 years = 1020 − 720 = 300, so yearly SI = 100; P = 720 − 2 × 100 = ₹520.

mcqs.q: If today is Monday, what day of the week will it be after 61 days?
mcqs.explanation: 61 ÷ 7 leaves remainder 5; Monday + 5 days = Saturday.

mcqs.q: 15 August 1947 was which day of the week?
mcqs.explanation: Independence Day 1947 (15 August) fell on a Friday — a standard historical calendar fact.

mcqs.q: 26 January 2025 was which day of the week?
mcqs.explanation: 1 Jan 2025 was Wednesday; 25 days later (25 mod 7 = 4) gives Wednesday + 4 = Sunday.

mcqs.q: How many odd days are there in 100 years?
mcqs.explanation: 100 years = 76 ordinary + 24 leap years → odd days = 76 + 48 = 124; 124 mod 7 = 5.

mcqs.q: Which day of the week can never be the last day of a century?
mcqs.explanation: 100/200/300/400-year cycles end on Friday, Wednesday, Monday and Sunday respectively; Tuesday (also Thursday, Saturday) is impossible.

mcqs.q: What is the angle between the two hands of a clock at 4:00?
mcqs.explanation: Hour hand at 4 → 4 × 30° = 120°; minute hand at 12; angle = 120°.

mcqs.q: What is the angle between the hands of a clock at 3:30?
How many times do the hour and minute hands of a clock coincide (overlap) in 24 hours?
mcqs.explanation: The hands coincide 11 times in 12 hours, so 22 times in 24 hours.

mcqs.q: How many times in a day are the hands of a clock at right angles (90°)?
mcqs.explanation: Hands form 90° 22 times in 12 hours, hence 44 times in 24 hours.

mcqs.q: At what time between 4 and 5 o'clock will the hands of a clock coincide?
mcqs.explanation: Coincidence time = (60 × 4)/11 = 240/11 = 21 9/11 minutes past 4.

mcqs.q: A watch gains 5 minutes every day. If it is set right at noon today, after how many days will it again show the correct time?
mcqs.explanation: It must gain 12 hours = 720 minutes; 720 ÷ 5 = 144 days.

mcqs.q: A clock shows 5:40. What time does its mirror image (reflection in a vertical mirror) show?
mcqs.explanation: Mirror time = 12:00 − 5:40 = 6:20 (subtract from 11:60).

mcqs.q: साधा व्याज: ₹1000 वर 2 वर्ष 5% दराने साधा व्याज?
वेळ-काम: A 6 तासांत, B 12 तासांत. दोघे एकत्र?
वेग: 60 किमी/ता वेगाने 3 तासांत अंतर?
क्षेत्रफळ: आयत 8×6 चे क्षेत्रफळ?
संभाव्यता: नाणे उछालल्यास टवळ किती संभाव्यता?
चक्रवाढ व्याज: ₹1000 वर 2 वर्ष 10% CI?
वेळ-काम: 5 माणसे 10 दिवसांत. 10 माणसे किती दिवसांत?
क्षेत्रफळ: त्रिकोण बाजू 6 सेमी, उंची 4 सेमी. क्षेत्रफळ?
संभाव्यता: पासा टाकल्यास 6 येण्याची संभाव्यता?
What is the smallest 4-digit number exactly divisible by 9?
mcqs.explanation: 1000 ÷ 9 leaves remainder 1, so add (9 − 1) = 8 to get 1008 = 9 × 112. Shortcut: smallest 4-digit number + (divisor − remainder).

mcqs.q: What is the unit digit of 7^45?
mcqs.explanation: Powers of 7 end in the cycle 7, 9, 3, 1 (period 4). Since 45 ÷ 4 leaves remainder 1, the unit digit is the 1st in the cycle = 7.

mcqs.q: How many numbers between 200 and 500 are exactly divisible by 13?
Which of the following fractions is the largest?
mcqs.explanation: In decimals: 0.667, 0.75, 0.80, 0.833 — so 5/6 is the largest. Cross-multiplication gives the same result.

mcqs.q: 0.7777... (7 recurring) expressed as a fraction is:
mcqs.explanation: A single repeating digit d equals d/9, so 0.777... = 7/9.

mcqs.q: The HCF of 36, 48 and 60 is:
The LCM of 12, 15 and 20 is:
The HCF and LCM of two numbers are 6 and 72. If one number is 24, the other number is:
mcqs.explanation: Product of the two numbers = HCF × LCM = 6 × 72 = 432; other number = 432 ÷ 24 = 18.

mcqs.q: A courtyard 16 m × 24 m is to be paved with the largest possible square tiles. How many tiles are needed?
mcqs.explanation: Tile side = HCF(16, 24) = 8 m; number of tiles = (16 × 24) ÷ (8 × 8) = 384 ÷ 64 = 6.
35 × 35 = 1225; a perfect square ending in 25 always has a root ending in 5.
0.09 × 0.09 = 0.0081. Shortcut: group decimal places in pairs — 4 places here means 2 places in the root.

mcqs.q: ₹720 is divided among A, B and C in the ratio 1 : 2 : 3. C's share is:
mcqs.explanation: Total parts = 6, so one part = 720 ÷ 6 = 120; C = 3 × 120 = ₹360.

mcqs.q: Two numbers are in the ratio 3 : 4. If 6 is added to each, the ratio becomes 4 : 5. The numbers are:
If A : B = 2 : 3 and B : C = 4 : 5, then A : C = ?
mcqs.explanation: Make B equal in both ratios: A : B : C = 8 : 12 : 15, hence A : C = 8 : 15.

mcqs.q: The fourth proportional to 5, 8 and 15 is:
In a class of 40 students, boys and girls are in the ratio 5 : 3. The number of girls is:
mcqs.explanation: Total parts = 8, one part = 5; girls = 3 × 5 = 15 (boys 25 + girls 15 = 40).

mcqs.q: A family's monthly income and expenditure are in the ratio 7 : 4. If monthly savings are ₹9,000, the monthly income is:
mcqs.explanation: Savings = 7 − 4 = 3 parts = 9,000, so one part = 3,000; income = 7 × 3,000 = ₹21,000.

mcqs.q: The average of the first 10 natural numbers is:
mcqs.explanation: Sum of 1 to 10 = 55; average = 55 ÷ 10 = 5.5. Shortcut: average of consecutive numbers = (first + last)/2 = (1 + 10)/2.

mcqs.q: The average weight of 5 boys is 40 kg. If a boy weighing 30 kg leaves the group, the new average is:
mcqs.explanation: Total = 5 × 40 = 200; after removal 200 − 30 = 170 ÷ 4 = 42.5 kg.

mcqs.q: The average age of 24 students and their teacher is 16 years. When the teacher's age is excluded, the average drops to 15 years. The teacher's age is:
The average of 11 results is 50. The average of the first six is 49 and of the last six is 52. The sixth result is:
mcqs.explanation: (6 × 49) + (6 × 52) = 606 counts the sixth result twice; sixth result = 606 − (11 × 50) = 606 − 550 = 56.

mcqs.q: If the price of sugar rises by 25%, by what percent must a family reduce its consumption so that the expenditure remains unchanged?
mcqs.explanation: Required cut = 25/(100 + 25) × 100 = 20%. Shortcut: for a rise of 1/n, the cut is 1/(n+1).

mcqs.q: A number is increased by 40% and then decreased by 40%. The final value is 840. The original number is:
mcqs.explanation: Net factor = 1.40 × 0.60 = 0.84; original number = 840 ÷ 0.84 = 1000.

mcqs.q: A candidate scoring 35% fails by 30 marks, while a candidate scoring 45% gets 10 marks more than the pass mark. The maximum marks are:
mcqs.explanation: 0.35T + 30 = 0.45T − 10 ⇒ 0.10T = 40 ⇒ T = 400 (pass mark = 170, verified both ways).

mcqs.q: Find the least number which, when divided by 16 and 20, leaves remainder 5 in each case.
How many perfect squares lie between 1 and 100 (both inclusive)?
mcqs.explanation: The squares 1², 2², ..., 10² all lie between 1 and 100, giving exactly 10.

mcqs.q: A stationery shop sold pens on weekdays as follows: Mon 40, Tue 50, Wed 30, Thu 60, Fri 70. What was the total number of pens sold from Monday to Friday?
A factory produced 1,200 units in January, 1,500 in February and 1,800 in March. The percentage increase in production from January to March is:
A student scored 60, 70, 80, 90 and 100 in five subjects. The average score is:
mcqs.explanation: Sum = 400; average = 400 ÷ 5 = 80.

mcqs.q: Three partners A, B and C invest in the ratio 2 : 3 : 5. From a total profit of ₹40,000, C's share is:
A village's population grew from 8,000 to 10,000 in five years. The percentage increase is:
Four schools have enrolments P = 400, Q = 350, R = 250 and S = 200. The total enrolment is:
A library has Fiction 300, Non-fiction 500 and Reference 200 books. The ratio of Fiction books to total books is:
mcqs.explanation: Total = 1,000; Fiction : Total = 300 : 1000 = 3 : 10.

mcqs.q: A family budget of ₹36,000 is allocated as: Rent 25%, Food 40%, Education 20% and Savings 15%. The amount spent on food is:
For the same budget of ₹36,000 (Rent 25%, Education 20%), how much more is spent on rent than on education?
Maximum temperatures for five days were 30°C, 32°C, 33°C, 31°C and 34°C. The average maximum temperature is:
mcqs.explanation: Sum = 160; average = 160 ÷ 5 = 32°C.

mcqs.q: In a parking lot of 500 vehicles, 150 are two-wheelers. What percentage of the vehicles are two-wheelers?
A shop's monthly sales fell from ₹80,000 to ₹60,000. The percentage decrease is:
Three friends share ₹1,500 in the ratio 2 : 3 : 5. The smallest share is:
mcqs.explanation: One part = 1500 ÷ 10 = 150; smallest share = 2 × 150 = ₹300.

mcqs.q: Class X has 40 boys and 20 girls; Class Y has 30 boys and 30 girls. The total number of students in the two classes is:
mcqs.explanation: Class X = 60 and Class Y = 60; total = 120.

mcqs.q: For the same two classes (X: 40 boys + 20 girls; Y: 30 boys + 30 girls), the ratio of total boys to total girls is:
A cricket team scored 180, 220, 250 and 150 runs in four matches. The average score is:
mcqs.explanation: Total = 800; average = 800 ÷ 4 = 200.

mcqs.q: In a survey of 800 people, 45% preferred tea and 40% preferred coffee; the rest preferred neither. How many people preferred neither?
Job applications to a department rose from 1,500 to 1,800 in a year. The percentage increase is:
A housing society has 350 members, with men : women = 4 : 3. The number of women is:
mcqs.explanation: 7 parts = 350, one part = 50; women = 3 × 50 = 150.

mcqs.q: Crop production (in tonnes) was: 2020: 500; 2021: 600; 2022: 550; 2023: 750. In which year was production the highest?
mcqs.explanation: 750 in 2023 is the largest value in the series.

mcqs.q: For the same crop data (2020: 500 tonnes to 2023: 750 tonnes), the percentage increase from 2020 to 2023 is:
Monthly savings were: Jan ₹2,000, Feb ₹2,500, Mar ₹1,500, Apr ₹2,000. The average monthly saving is:
In a class of 60 students, 30% play cricket, 25% play football and the rest play basketball. How many students play basketball?
A firm has employees in HR : Finance : IT in the ratio 2 : 3 : 5, with 200 employees in total. How many are in IT?
For the same firm (HR : Finance : IT = 2 : 3 : 5, total 200), HR staff form what percentage of all employees?
A product's price rises by 10% and then falls by 10%. The net change in price is:
mcqs.explanation: Net factor = 1.10 × 0.90 = 0.99, i.e. a net 1% decrease (successive change is never zero).

mcqs.q: The average of six numbers is 18. If each number is increased by 3, the new average is:
mcqs.explanation: Adding a constant to every number adds the same constant to the average: 18 + 3 = 21.

mcqs.q: Shop A sold 120 pens at ₹15 each; Shop B sold 80 pens at ₹20 each. Which shop earned more revenue, and by how much?
Of 1,200 students in a college, 55% are girls. The number of boys is:
Monthly electricity consumption (units): House P 120, Q 90, R 150, S 60. The total consumption is:
For the same electricity data (R = 150 units, S = 60 units), house S's consumption is what percentage of house R's?
A school's pass percentage rose from 60% to 72%. The rise, in percentage points, is:
mcqs.explanation: 72 − 60 = 12 percentage points (the relative increase would be 20%, but 'percentage points' means the simple difference).

mcqs.q: The average marks of 40 students is 50. If 10 more students with an average of 70 join the class, the new class average is:
₹6,800 is divided among X, Y and Z such that X : Y = 3 : 4 and Y : Z = 2 : 5. Z's share is:
In an office of 90 staff, 36 are women. The ratio of men to women is:
A 500-litre tank has 40% of its water used on day 1 and 50% of the remainder on day 2. The water left after day 2 is:
mcqs.explanation: Day 1: 500 − 200 = 300 L; day 2: half of 300 = 150 used, leaving 150 L.

mcqs.q: A batsman's average after 10 innings is 45 runs. How many runs must he score in the 11th innings to raise his average to 47?
mcqs.explanation: Required total = 11 × 47 = 517; current total = 10 × 45 = 450; runs needed = 517 − 450 = 67.

mcqs.q: In an election between two candidates, 5,000 votes were polled and the winner secured 60% of them. The loser's votes were:
mcqs.explanation: Loser = 40% of 5,000 = 2,000 (winner had 3,000).

mcqs.q: For the same election (5,000 votes, winner 60%), the margin of victory was:
A bookshop's daily sales were: Mon 25, Tue 30, Wed 20, Thu 35, Fri 40 books. The average daily sale for these five days is:
mcqs.explanation: Total = 150; average = 150 ÷ 5 = 30 books.

mcqs.q: Read the passage: 'In the hills of Uttarakhand, villagers once walked for hours to fetch water. After check-dams and rooftop tanks were built, spring flow revived and the walking time halved. Women's water-user committees now repair leaks within a day.' What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Hill villages can never solve water problems
Community-managed water conservation has visibly improved daily life
mcqs.explanation: The passage links community-built structures and committees to halved walking time and quick leak repairs — improved daily life is the central point.

mcqs.q: Read the passage: 'A study of 10,000 commuters found that those who shifted from cars to cycles reported better moods within a month, though travel time rose slightly. For most riders, the health gains outweighed the extra minutes.' What can be inferred?
options: Cycling is always faster than driving
A slightly longer commute did not erase the well-being benefit of cycling
Cars cause bad moods in all cases
The study covered only one city
mcqs.explanation: 'Though travel time rose slightly... better moods' implies the mood benefit survived the slightly longer commute; nothing stronger is claimed.

mcqs.q: Read the passage: 'The committee's report congratulates itself on unprecedented progress, yet the same page shows that funds fell from ₹40 crore to ₹22 crore and completed projects halved.' The tone of the author is:
mcqs.explanation: Placing the self-praise against falling funds and halved output exposes the boast, so the author's tone is critical.

mcqs.q: Read the passage: 'The district library now opens at 7 a.m., two hours earlier than before. Within weeks a steady queue of students forms at dawn, and the reading hall is full by 8 a.m.' The best conclusion is:
options: The library will close down soon
Earlier opening met a genuine demand among students
The queue is for some other office
mcqs.explanation: A regular dawn queue and a full hall right after the timing change show the earlier opening answered a real need.

mcqs.q: Read the passage: 'Migratory birds returned to the lake only after the municipality stopped releasing sewage into it and replanted the reed beds. Neither step alone had worked when tried earlier.' The passage suggests that:
options: The birds returned because both steps were carried out together
mcqs.explanation: 'Only after... and...' plus 'neither step alone had worked' points to the combined action as the cause of the return.

mcqs.q: Read the passage: 'A farmer grew millets instead of paddy on one acre as a trial. Water use halved and the millets fetched a premium in the city market. Next season he plans to convert three more acres.' What does the passage imply?
options: The trial's savings and profit convinced the farmer to expand
Millets cannot be sold in cities
mcqs.explanation: Halved water use plus better prices directly led to the plan of expanding — that is the implication.

mcqs.q: Read the passage: 'The minister's speech was verbose, yet the audience waited patiently for the one concrete promise hidden in the verbiage.' Here 'verbose' means:
mcqs.explanation: A promise 'hidden in the verbiage' indicates an excess of words, i.e. wordy.

mcqs.q: Read the passage: 'Though the firm advertised family-friendly hours, its latest schedule makes night shifts compulsory for parents of infants.' What does the passage highlight?
options: The actual policy contradicts the advertised claim
mcqs.explanation: The word 'Though' signals a contradiction between the advertisement and the real practice.

mcqs.q: Read the passage: 'In 1990 a letter took a week to arrive; today a message travels in a second. Yet hand-written letters are still treasured in cupboards, while countless chats are deleted every day.' The central idea is:
options: Speed has made all writing worthless
The emotional value of letters outlives instant digital messages
mcqs.explanation: The contrast — letters kept for years versus chats deleted daily — shows that sentimental value outlasts speed.

mcqs.q: Read the passage: 'The cyclist pedalled uphill for an hour only to find the pass closed by fog. She smiled, brewed tea and waited, saying the mountain sets the timetable.' Her attitude is best described as:
mcqs.explanation: Smiling and calmly waiting show acceptance rather than frustration.

mcqs.q: By the time the guests arrived, the chef ____ all the starters.
mcqs.explanation: An action completed before another past action takes the past perfect tense: 'had prepared'.

mcqs.q: He is ____ honest officer.
mcqs.explanation: 'Honest' begins with a vowel sound (the h is silent), so 'an' is used.

mcqs.q: The meeting has been put ____ till Friday.
